source.text: ר֛וּחַ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה עָלָ֑י יַ֡עַן מָשַׁח֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֹתִ֜י לְבַשֵּׂ֣ר עֲנָוִ֗ים שְׁלָחַ֨נִי֙ לַחֲבֹ֣שׁ לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵ֔ב לִקְרֹ֤א לִשְׁבוּיִם֙ דְּר֔וֹר וְלַאֲסוּרִ֖ים פְּקַח־קֽוֹחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] Spirit of [the] Lord Yahweh [is] on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to bring good news to [the] humble; he has sent me to bind up [the] broken of heart, to proclaim to captives liberty, and to [those] bound opening-opening,

en.L: [The] Spirit of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} [is] upon me, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has anointed me to bring good news to [the] lowly; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has sent me to bind up [the] broken of heart, \q to proclaim to captives release, and to [those] bound, [eyes] opened wide,
en.B: The Spirit of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} rests on me, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has anointed me to carry good news to the lowly. \q He has sent me to bandage hearts that are broken, \q to announce freedom for captives and, for those in chains, eyes opened wide,
en.R: The Spirit of the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} is on me. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has anointed me, choosing me for this work. He sent me to bring good news to poor people. \q He sent me to heal people whose hearts are broken. \q He sent me to tell captives that they are free, and to tell prisoners that they will see the light again.

es.L: El Espíritu del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} [está] sobre mí, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha ungido para anunciar buenas noticias a los humildes; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me ha enviado a vendar a los quebrantados de corazón, \q a proclamar libertad a los cautivos, y a los prisioneros, apertura [de ojos],
es.B: El Espíritu del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} reposa sobre mí, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha ungido para llevar buenas noticias a los humildes. \q Él me ha enviado a vendar los corazones heridos, \q a anunciar libertad a los cautivos y, a los que están encadenados, ojos bien abiertos,
es.R: El Espíritu del Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} está sobre mí. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha ungido, escogiéndome para esta tarea. Me envió a llevar buenas noticias a los pobres. \q Me envió a sanar a los que tienen el corazón destrozado. \q Me envió a decirles a los cautivos que son libres, y a los presos que volverán a ver la luz.

fr.L: L’Esprit du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} [est] sur moi, \q parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a oint pour porter la bonne nouvelle aux pauvres ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a envoyé pour panser ceux qui ont le cœur brisé, \q pour proclamer aux captifs la libération, et aux prisonniers [les yeux] grands ouverts,
fr.B: L’Esprit du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} repose sur moi, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a oint pour apporter la bonne nouvelle aux pauvres. \q Il m’a envoyé panser les cœurs brisés, \q annoncer aux captifs la liberté et, à ceux qui sont enchaînés, des yeux grands ouverts,
fr.R: L’Esprit du Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} est sur moi. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a oint, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a choisi pour ce travail. Il m’a envoyé apporter la bonne nouvelle aux pauvres. \q Il m’a envoyé guérir ceux qui ont le cœur brisé. \q Il m’a envoyé dire aux captifs qu’ils sont libres, et aux prisonniers qu’ils verront de nouveau la lumière.

sw.L: Roho wa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} [yuko] juu yangu, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenipaka mafuta niwaletee wanyonge habari njema; \q amenituma kuwafunga majeraha waliovunjika moyo, \q kuwatangazia mateka kuachiliwa, na [wale] waliofungwa, [macho] kufumbuliwa kabisa,
sw.B: Roho wa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} anakaa juu yangu, \q kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenipaka mafuta niwapelekee wanyenyekevu habari njema. \q Amenituma kuifunga mioyo iliyovunjika, \q kutangaza uhuru kwa mateka, na kwa walio katika minyororo, macho kufunguliwa,
sw.R: Roho wa Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} yuko juu yangu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenipaka mafuta, akanichagua kwa kazi hii. Alinituma kuwaletea maskini habari njema. \q Alinituma kuwaponya watu waliovunjika moyo. \q Alinituma kuwaambia mateka kwamba wako huru, na kuwaambia wafungwa kwamba wataona nuru tena.

vi.L: Thần Linh của Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] trên tôi, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho tôi để đem tin lành cho [những người] khiêm nhường; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã sai tôi để băng bó [những người có] tấm lòng tan vỡ, \q để công bố sự giải phóng cho những kẻ bị bắt, và cho [những kẻ] bị xiềng, [đôi mắt] được mở ra,
vi.B: Thần Linh của Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự trên tôi, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho tôi để mang tin lành đến cho người khiêm hạ. \q Ngài đã sai tôi đến để băng bó những tấm lòng tan vỡ, \q để loan báo tự do cho người bị bắt, và cho người bị xiềng xích được mở mắt ra,
vi.R: Thần Linh của Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên tôi. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho tôi, chọn tôi cho công việc này. Ngài đã sai tôi đem tin vui đến cho người nghèo. \q Ngài đã sai tôi chữa lành những người có tấm lòng tan nát. \q Ngài đã sai tôi nói với những người bị bắt rằng họ được tự do, và nói với những người bị tù rằng họ sẽ lại thấy ánh sáng.

ko.L: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 영이 내 위에 [계시다]. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 기름을 부으셔서 낮은 자들에게 좋은 소식을 전하게 하셨기 때문이다. \q 그분이 나를 보내셔서 마음이 상한 자들을 싸매게 하시고, \q 포로들에게 놓임을, 갇힌 자들에게 [눈이] 활짝 열림을 선포하게 하셨다.
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 영이 내 위에 머물러 계신다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 기름을 부으셔서 낮은 사람들에게 기쁜 소식을 전하게 하셨다. \q 그분이 나를 보내셔서 상한 마음을 싸매 주게 하시고, \q 포로들에게 자유를, 사슬에 묶인 사람들에게 눈이 활짝 열림을 알리게 하셨다.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 영이 내 위에 계신다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 기름을 부으셔서 이 일을 하도록 나를 택하셨다. 그분이 나를 보내셔서 가난한 사람들에게 기쁜 소식을 전하게 하셨다. \q 그분이 나를 보내셔서 마음이 상한 사람들을 고쳐 주게 하셨다. \q 그분이 나를 보내셔서 포로들에게 그들이 자유라고 알리고, 갇힌 사람들에게 그들이 다시 빛을 보게 될 것이라고 알리게 하셨다.

pt.L: [O] Espírito do Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} [está] sobre mim, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me ungiu para anunciar boas-novas aos humildes; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me enviou para enfaixar [os] partidos de coração, \q para proclamar aos cativos libertação, e aos presos, [olhos] bem abertos,
pt.B: O Espírito do Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} repousa sobre mim, \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me ungiu para levar boas-novas aos humildes. \q Ele me enviou para fazer curativos nos corações partidos, \q para anunciar liberdade aos cativos e, para os que estão acorrentados, olhos bem abertos,
pt.R: O Espírito do Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} está sobre mim. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me ungiu e me escolheu para este trabalho. Ele me enviou para levar boas-novas aos pobres. \q Ele me enviou para curar as pessoas de coração partido. \q Ele me enviou para dizer aos cativos que estão livres e aos presos que vão ver a luz de novo.

am.L: የጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ [ነው]፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለትሑታን ወንጌልን እሰብክ ዘንድ ቀብቶኛልና፤ \q ልባቸው የተሰበረውን እጠግን ዘንድ ልኮኛል፤ \q ለታሰሩት መፈታትን፣ ለእስረኞችም [የዓይን] ፈጽሞ መከፈትን እንዳውጅ፣
am.B: የጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለትሑታን ወንጌልን እንዳበሥር ቀብቶኛልና። \q የተሰበሩ ልቦችን እንድጠግን ልኮኛል፤ \q ለታሰሩት መፈታትን፣ በሰንሰለት ላሉትም ዓይኖቻቸው በሰፊው እንደሚከፈቱ እንዳውጅ፣
am.R: የጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቀብቶኛል፤ ለዚህም ሥራ መርጦኛል። ለድሆች የምሥራችን እንድነግር ልኮኛል። \q ልባቸው የተሰበረውን ሰዎች እንድፈውስ ልኮኛል። \q እስረኞች እንደሚፈቱ፣ የታሰሩትም እንደ ገና ብርሃን እንደሚያዩ እንድነግራቸው ልኮኛል።

hi.L: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} का आत्मा मुझ पर [है], \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे अभिषिक्त किया है कि दीनों को सुसमाचार दूँ; \q उन्होंने मुझे भेजा है कि टूटे मनवालों की मरहम-पट्टी करूँ, \q कि क़ैदियों के लिए छुटकारे की, और बँधे हुओं के लिए [आँखें] पूरी तरह खुलने की घोषणा करूँ,
hi.B: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} का आत्मा मुझ पर है, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दीनों को सुसमाचार सुनाने के लिए मेरा अभिषेक किया है। \q उन्होंने मुझे भेजा है कि टूटे हृदयों पर पट्टी बाँधूँ, \q बंदियों को रिहाई का संदेश दूँ, और जो ज़ंजीरों में हैं उन्हें आँखें पूरी तरह खुलने का,
hi.R: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} का आत्मा मुझ पर है। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मेरा अभिषेक किया है, इस काम के लिए मुझे चुना है। उन्होंने मुझे भेजा है कि ग़रीब लोगों को सुसमाचार सुनाऊँ। \q उन्होंने मुझे भेजा है कि जिनके दिल टूटे हैं उन्हें चंगा करूँ। \q उन्होंने मुझे भेजा है कि क़ैदियों को बताऊँ कि वे आज़ाद हैं, और बंदियों को बताऊँ कि वे फिर से उजाला देखेंगे।

ru.L: Дух Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на мне, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} помазал меня благовестить смиренным; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} послал меня перевязать сокрушённых сердцем, \q проповедовать пленным освобождение и связанным — открытие [глаз],
ru.B: Дух Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на мне, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} помазал меня, чтобы принести радостную весть смиренным. \q Он послал меня перевязать разбитые сердца, \q возвестить пленникам свободу, а закованным — широко открытые глаза,
ru.R: Дух Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на мне. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} помазал меня, избрав меня для этого дела. Он послал меня рассказать бедным радостную весть. \q Он послал меня исцелить людей, чьи сердца разбиты. \q Он послал меня сказать пленникам, что их освободят, а узникам — что они снова увидят свет.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の霊がわたしの上に[ある]。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしに油を注がれたからだ。へりくだる者たちに良い知らせを伝えさせるために。 \q その方はわたしを遣わされた。心の砕かれた者たちを包み、 \q 捕らわれた者たちに解放を、つながれている者たちに[目が]大きく開かれることを告げ知らせ、
ja.B: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の霊が、わたしの上にとどまっている。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、わたしに油を注がれたからだ。貧しく低くされた人々に、良い知らせを伝えさせるためである。 \q その方は、わたしを遣わされた。心の傷ついた人々を包み、 \q 捕らわれた人々に自由を、鎖につながれた人々に目が大きく開かれることを告げ、
ja.R: {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の霊が、わたしの上にある。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしに油を注ぎ、この働きのためにわたしを選ばれた。貧しい人たちに良い知らせを伝えるために、わたしを遣わされた。 \q 心が傷ついた人たちをいやすために、わたしを遣わされた。 \q 捕らわれている人たちに、自由になると告げるため、囚人たちに、再び光を見ると告げるために、わたしを遣わされた。

decisions.choice: the speaker is one anointed and sent by the LORD, who is not named
decisions.reason: Someone speaks of himself. He may be the prophet, sent with God's message (48:16). He may be the servant of the LORD, on whom God put his Spirit (42:1) and who was sent to open blind eyes and free prisoners (42:7; 49:9). In Luke 4:16-21 Jesus reads these words in the synagogue at Nazareth and says, "Today this scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing."

decisions.choice: anointed: set apart by God for a task, here by the gift of his Spirit
decisions.reason: Kings, priests and sometimes prophets were anointed with oil for their office (1 Samuel 16:13; Exodus 28:41; 1 Kings 19:16). Here the anointing goes with the Spirit resting on the speaker, as with David in 1 Samuel 16:13 and the shoot of Jesse in 11:2.

decisions.choice: release: the freeing of slaves in the year of jubilee
decisions.reason: The word is used for the release proclaimed in the jubilee year (Leviticus 25:10) and for freeing slaves (Jeremiah 34:8, 15, 17). Verse 2 continues the picture with "a year of favor".

decisions.choice: eyes opened wide: a doubled word for complete opening, used of eyes
alternatives: the opening of the prison to those who are bound
recovery of sight to the blind
decisions.reason: The verb behind it is used of opening the eyes (42:7, 20), and prisoners led out of a dark dungeon see light again (42:7). Some take it as the opening of the prison itself. The Septuagint has "recovery of sight to the blind" here, and Luke 4:18 quotes that wording; Luke 4:18 also includes "to set free the oppressed", words from 58:6.

decisions.choice: choosing me for this work
decisions.reason: Readable explains what being anointed means (see m2).

decisions.choice: el Espíritu del Señor DIOS; me ha ungido; anunciar buenas noticias; libertad a los cautivos
decisions.reason: Luke 4:18 quotes this verse; Spanish keeps the key words of the published verse, as the terms note sets. The speaker's "mí" and "me" take no deity_pronoun span (the speaker of 61:1 is not spanned, as in English), though Luke 4:18 spans Jesus.

decisions.choice: Roho wa Bwana MUNGU [yuko] juu yangu; amenipaka mafuta; habari njema
decisions.reason: Luke 4:18 reads this line; its key words "Roho wa Bwana", "amenipaka mafuta" and "habari njema" are kept, and the rest is worded from the Hebrew. The speaker is not God, so "yangu" and "-ni-" take no span, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "L'Esprit du Seigneur DIEU est sur moi", "la bonne nouvelle aux pauvres"
decisions.reason: Luke 4:18-19 quotes these lines; French keeps the published key words at every level, including "pauvres" where the English Literal says "lowly". The speaker takes no deity_pronoun span ("moi", "m'"), as the English and the terms note.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của Chúa là CHÚA"
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles: Isaiah's "the Spirit of the Lord GOD" is "Thần Linh", as in 2 Samuel 23:2 and Psalm 139:7. Luke 4:18 has "Thánh Linh của Chúa", from the Greek; the words "xức dầu", "tin lành", "sai" and "tự do" are kept so that a reader can see the quotation. The drafting followed the Hebrew gloss and keeps clear of familiar Vietnamese wording.

decisions.choice: the speaker says "tôi", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As the terms note settles, the speaker of 61:1 takes no span; Luke 4:18 spans "Ta" only because Jesus reads the passage of himself. "Tin lành" stays lowercase, plain good news.

decisions.choice: the anointed speaker speaks in the plain style with 나 and gives the Spirit and the LORD the honorific ("계시다", "부으셔서")
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets, the speaker of 61:1 is "나" and takes no honorific himself; the honorific "계시다" for the Spirit matches Luke 4:18, which quotes the verse.

decisions.choice: "기름을 부으셔서", "좋은 소식/기쁜 소식", "포로들에게 놓임/자유"
decisions.reason: Luke 4:18-19 quotes these lines from the Greek with "복음"; Isaiah keeps "좋은 소식" (L) and "기쁜 소식" (B, R) for basar, as the terms note sets, while keeping "기름을 붓다" and "포로" so the quotation can be seen.

decisions.choice: anunciar / levar boas-novas; proclamar ... libertação (L), anunciar liberdade (B)
decisions.reason: Jesus reads these words in Luke 4:18-19 (m1), and Isaiah keeps the Portuguese of Luke at each level where the Hebrew is the same: "O Espírito do Senhor ... sobre mim", "me ungiu", "boas-novas", "me enviou", "libertação aos cativos" (L), "liberdade aos cativos" (B). Luke follows the Greek Old Testament where the Hebrew differs, and Isaiah follows the Hebrew: "o Senhor DEUS" with God's name, "os humildes" (B, L) for Luke's "os pobres", the broken-hearted, which Luke's text lacks, and eyes opened for the prisoners (m4) rather than "vista aos cegos".

decisions.choice: me, mim (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The speaker is not named (m1), and the English writes his "me" without a span, so Portuguese does too; the spans stay on the pronouns for the LORD who sends him. Luke 4:18, where Jesus is the speaker, has them.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Isaiah 61.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of Luke 4:18 where the Hebrew agrees: "የ... መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ [ነው]", "ቀብቶኛልና", "ወንጌልን እሰብክ ዘንድ" (L; B "እንዳበሥር"; R "የምሥራችን እንድነግር"), "ለታሰሩት መፈታትን ... እንዳውጅ ልኮኛል"; elsewhere the Hebrew
alternatives: Luke's wording throughout, with "ለዕውሮችም ማየትን" (recovery of sight to the blind)
decisions.reason: Jesus reads this passage in Luke 4:18-19, and the Greek there follows the Greek translation of Isaiah. Where it agrees with the Hebrew, Isaiah keeps the Luke Amharic. It departs where the Hebrew differs: "the Lord GOD" and the divine name ("ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}", Adonai YHWH, the Lord first as the terms list sets) where Luke has "the Lord"; "the lowly" (ʿanawim) "ትሑታን" at L and B, Luke's "ድሆች" (the poor) kept at R as the English R; the line on binding up the broken-hearted, which the Hebrew has; and the last line, where the Hebrew promises the bound "eyes opened wide" (meaning decision m4: from the dark of the prison) and the Greek says "recovery of sight to the blind". Isaiah follows the Hebrew and does not add Luke's "set the oppressed free", which comes from 58:6.

decisions.choice: the wording of Luke 4:18 where the Hebrew says the same: "का आत्मा मुझ पर", "अभिषिक्त किया" (L), "मेरा अभिषेक किया" (B), "सुसमाचार", "क़ैदियों", "छुटकारे की ... घोषणा" (L), "रिहाई" (B), "ग़रीब लोगों" (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus reads this passage in the synagogue at Nazareth (Luke 4:18-19), so where the Hebrew agrees, each level keeps the Hindi of Luke at the same level. The Hebrew "Lord GOD" stays "प्रभु परमेश्वर" as the Prophets note has it, where Luke has "प्रभु"; and "the lowly" is "दीनों" at Literal and Balanced, where Luke's Greek has "the poor".

decisions.choice: "बँधे हुओं के लिए [आँखें] पूरी तरह खुलने" from the Hebrew, not Luke's "अंधों के लिए फिर से देखने"
alternatives: "अंधों के लिए फिर से देखने की घोषणा" (Luke 4:18)
decisions.reason: Luke 4:18 follows the Greek Old Testament, "recovery of sight to the blind". The Hebrew says "to the bound, opening-opening", a doubled word for complete opening, used of eyes (meaning m4), probably the eyes of prisoners brought out of dark cells into the light; Hindi translates the Hebrew, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "प्रभु परमेश्वर" for the Lord GOD; no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: As the Prophets note: Adonai YHWH is "प्रभु" with the name as "परमेश्वर" under the divine_name setting, whose alternative gives "याहवे". Devanagari has no capitals, so the deity_pronoun spans have nothing to change; God takes honorific forms ("उन्होंने").

decisions.choice: the wording of Luke 4:18 where the Hebrew agrees ("Дух ... на мне", "помазал меня благовестить", "проповедовать пленным освобождение", "радостную весть", "возвестить пленникам свободу")
decisions.reason: Jesus reads this passage in Luke 4:18-19; where the Hebrew says the same, the wording of Luke 4:18-19 in this translation is kept at each level. Isaiah has "the Lord GOD" (Владыка ГОСПОДЬ) where Luke has "the Lord", and the speaker's "me" takes no deity_pronoun span here, as the English (the speaker is not named, m1), where Luke's has one for Jesus.

decisions.choice: "связанным — открытие [глаз]" (L); "закованным — широко открытые глаза" (B); "узникам — что они снова увидят свет" (R)
decisions.reason: Luke 4:18 follows the Greek Old Testament, "recovery of sight to the blind". The Hebrew has "to the bound, opening-opening", a doubled word used of opening the eyes (m4): prisoners brought out of darkness into light. This translation follows the Hebrew and keeps Luke's wording for Luke.

decisions.choice: "смиренным" (L, B); "бедным" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the lowly and afflicted; Literal and Balanced say "смиренным" as the English says "lowly"; Readable says "бедным", as Luke 4:18 has it at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: Checked against LUK 4:18-19 ja and drafted from the Hebrew: 'adonai YHWH "主なる神" in one divine_name span (ISA-1); mashach "油を注がれた" (L, B) with no christos span, as the English has none (ISA-6 45:1 rule); levasser "良い知らせを伝える" (every level), the OT word for mevasser (40:9, 52:7), not Luke's "福音を告げ知らせる" from the Greek; 'anawim "へりくだる者たち" (L, 29:19), "貧しく低くされた人々" (B), "貧しい人たち" (R, as Luke R).
decisions.reason: The NT quotation follows the Greek; the Hebrew here has its own words.

decisions.choice: The anointed speaker (m1) speaks in plain verse as "わたし", with light respect forms for the LORD's acts ("注がれた", "遣わされた"), as the later Luke drafts; deror "解放" (L), "自由" (B, R), the jubilee release (m3); peqach-qoach "[目が]大きく開かれること" (L), the doubled word read of eyes (m4).
decisions.reason: A human speaker keeps respect forms for God.

records.literal_gloss: to proclaim a year of favor of Yahweh and a day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all mourners,

en.L: to proclaim a year of favor of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q and a day of vengeance of our God, \q to comfort all [who] mourn,
en.B: to announce a year when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shows favor \q and a day when our God takes vengeance, \q to console all who grieve,
en.R: He sent me to announce that the time has come for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to show kindness. \q It is the day for our God to punish {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies. \q He sent me to comfort everyone who is sad.

es.L: a proclamar el año favorable {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} \q y el día de la venganza de nuestro Dios, \q a consolar a todos los que lloran,
es.B: a anunciar el año en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} muestra su favor \q y el día en que nuestro Dios toma venganza, \q a consolar a todos los que están de luto,
es.R: Me envió a anunciar que ha llegado el tiempo en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mostrará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} bondad. \q Es el día en que nuestro Dios castigará a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos. \q Me envió a consolar a todos los que están tristes.

fr.L: pour proclamer l’année de la faveur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} \q et le jour de la vengeance de notre Dieu, \q pour consoler tous ceux qui sont en deuil,
fr.B: pour annoncer l’année de la faveur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} \q et le jour où notre Dieu fera justice, \q pour consoler tous ceux qui pleurent,
fr.R: Il m’a envoyé annoncer que le moment est venu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de montrer {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonté. \q C’est le jour où notre Dieu punira {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis. \q Il m’a envoyé consoler tous ceux qui sont tristes.

sw.L: kutangaza mwaka wa kibali wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q na siku ya kisasi ya Mungu wetu, \q kuwafariji wote [wanaoomboleza],
sw.B: kutangaza mwaka ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataonyesha kibali {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}, \q na siku ambayo Mungu wetu atalipiza kisasi, \q kuwafariji wote wenye huzuni,
sw.R: Alinituma kutangaza kwamba wakati umefika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuonyesha wema {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Ni siku ya Mungu wetu kuwaadhibu adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \q Alinituma kuwafariji wote walio na huzuni.

vi.L: để công bố năm ân huệ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q và ngày báo thù của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, \q để an ủi mọi [người] than khóc,
vi.B: để loan báo năm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ ân huệ \q và ngày Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta báo thù, \q để yên ủi mọi người đang sầu khổ,
vi.R: Ngài đã sai tôi loan báo rằng đã đến lúc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ lòng nhân từ. \q Đó là ngày Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta trừng phạt các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài đã sai tôi an ủi mọi người đang buồn rầu.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 은혜의 해와 \q 우리 하나님의 보복의 날을 선포하며, \q 슬퍼하는 모든 자를 위로하게 하셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 은혜를 베푸시는 해와 \q 우리 하나님께서 원수를 갚으시는 날을 알리고, \q 슬퍼하는 모든 사람을 위로하게 하셨다.
ko.R: 그분이 나를 보내셔서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 은혜를 베푸실 때가 왔다고 알리게 하셨다. \q 지금은 우리 하나님께서 그분의 원수들을 벌하실 날이다. \q 그분이 나를 보내셔서 슬퍼하는 모든 사람을 위로하게 하셨다.

pt.L: para proclamar um ano de favor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} \q e um dia de vingança do nosso Deus, \q para consolar todos os enlutados,
pt.B: para anunciar um ano de favor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} \q e um dia em que o nosso Deus se vinga, \q para consolar todos os que estão de luto,
pt.R: Ele me enviou para anunciar que chegou o tempo de {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} mostrar bondade. \q É o dia de o nosso Deus castigar os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} inimigos. \q Ele me enviou para consolar todos os que estão tristes.

am.L: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} የተወደደ ዓመት፣ \q የአምላካችንንም የበቀል ቀን እንዳውጅ፣ \q ያዘኑትንም ሁሉ አጽናና ዘንድ፣
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሞገሱን የሚያሳይበትን ዓመት፣ \q አምላካችንም የሚበቀልበትን ቀን እንዳውጅ፣ \q ያዘኑትንም ሁሉ እንዳጽናና፣
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቸርነቱን የሚያሳይበት ጊዜ እንደ ደረሰ እንዳውጅ ልኮኛል። \q አምላካችን ጠላቶቹን የሚቀጣበት ቀን ይህ ነው። \q ያዘኑትን ሁሉ እንዳጽናና ልኮኛል።

hi.L: कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की कृपा के वर्ष की \q और हमारे परमेश्वर के बदला लेने के दिन की घोषणा करूँ, \q कि सब विलाप करनेवालों को सांत्वना दूँ,
hi.B: कि उस वर्ष की घोषणा करूँ जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कृपा करते हैं \q और उस दिन की जब हमारे परमेश्वर बदला लेते हैं, \q कि सब शोक करनेवालों को सांत्वना दूँ,
hi.R: उन्होंने मुझे यह घोषणा करने भेजा है कि वह समय आ गया है जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} दया करेंगे। \q यह वह दिन है जब हमारे परमेश्वर अपने शत्रुओं को दंड देंगे। \q उन्होंने मुझे भेजा है कि जो दुखी हैं उन सबको सांत्वना दूँ।

ru.L: проповедовать год благоволения {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} \q и день мщения нашего Бога, \q утешить всех плачущих,
ru.B: возвестить год, когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} являет свою милость, \q и день, когда наш Бог совершает мщение, \q утешить всех скорбящих,
ru.R: Он послал меня сказать, что пришло время, когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} окажет милость. \q Это день, когда наш Бог накажет своих врагов. \q Он послал меня утешить всех, кому грустно.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の恵みの年と、 \q わたしたちの神の復讐の日とを告げ知らせ、 \q すべての嘆く者を慰め、
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が恵みを示される年と、 \q わたしたちの神が報復される日とを告げ、 \q 嘆き悲しむすべての人を慰め、
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が優しくしてくださる時が来たと告げるために、わたしを遣わされた。 \q それは、わたしたちの神が、ご自分の敵を罰せられる日でもある。 \q その方は、悲しんでいるすべての人を慰めるために、わたしを遣わされた。

decisions.choice: a year of favor of the LORD: a time of grace that recalls the jubilee year
decisions.reason: With "release" in verse 1, the words recall the jubilee, the year in which debts were cancelled, land returned and slaves set free (Leviticus 25:8-13). The word "favor" is the same as in 49:8 ("in a time of favor I have answered you") and 60:10.

decisions.choice: a day of vengeance: the day God brings justice against those who oppressed his people
decisions.reason: Vengeance in these chapters is God's just repayment of Zion's enemies, which is the other side of her rescue (34:8; 35:4; 59:17-18; 63:4). A year of favor is set beside a day of vengeance: the favor lasts far longer.

decisions.choice: Luke 4:19 stops before "a day of vengeance"
decisions.reason: When Jesus reads this passage in Luke 4:18-19, he ends with the year of the Lord's favor and closes the scroll.

decisions.choice: to punish his enemies
decisions.reason: Readable says who the vengeance is against, as the context shows (59:18; 63:4).

decisions.choice: el año favorable del SEÑOR
alternatives: el año de la buena voluntad
decisions.reason: Luke 4:19 has "el año favorable del Señor"; Literal keeps the same words so the quotation can be seen.

decisions.choice: mwaka wa kibali wa YHWH
decisions.reason: "The year of the LORD's favor" keeps "mwaka wa kibali", as Luke 4:19 and the terms note; Readable explains it as the time for God's kindness.

decisions.choice: "l'année de la faveur du SEIGNEUR"
decisions.reason: Luke 4:19 quotes this line as "l'année de la faveur du Seigneur"; Literal and Balanced keep that wording, with the article French needs.

decisions.choice: um ano de favor do SENHOR (L, B); mostrar bondade (R)
decisions.reason: Luke 4:19 ends with this line (m3), "[o] ano favorável do Senhor" (L), "o ano do favor do Senhor" (B), "mostrar bondade" (R). Isaiah keeps "favor" and Readable's "mostrar bondade", with the Hebrew's "a year" and God's name; the word is the same "favor" as in 49:8 and 60:10.

decisions.choice: the year of favor as Luke 4:19: "የተወደደ ዓመት ... እንዳውጅ" (L), "... ሞገሱን የሚያሳይበትን ዓመት እንዳውጅ" (B), "... ቸርነቱን የሚያሳይበት" (R), with the divine name where Luke has "the Lord"; "a day of vengeance" "የበቀል ቀን"
alternatives: "የሞገስ ዓመት" (year of favor) at L, closer to the Hebrew ratson
decisions.reason: The Hebrew and the Greek agree on the year of favor, so each level keeps the Luke Amharic. Luke stops before the day of vengeance (meaning decision m3); the line is the Hebrew's, kept plain. "ያዘኑትን ... አጽናና" (comfort those who mourn) uses the verb of Matthew 5:4 ("የሚያዝኑ ... ይጽናናሉ"), which echoes this line.

decisions.choice: "प्रभु की कृपा के वर्ष की घोषणा" (L) and "उस वर्ष की घोषणा ... जब प्रभु कृपा करते हैं" (B), as Luke 4:19
decisions.reason: Luke 4:19 quotes this line and stops before "a day of vengeance" (meaning m3); the first line keeps Luke's Hindi at each level, with "प्रभु" under the divine_name setting since the Hebrew has the name.

decisions.choice: "проповедовать год благоволения ГОСПОДА" (L); "возвестить год, когда ГОСПОДЬ являет свою милость" (B)
decisions.reason: The words Luke 4:19 quotes, in the wording of Luke 4:19 in this translation at Literal and Balanced; Luke stops before "the day of vengeance" (m3).

decisions.choice: shenat ratson laYHWH "主の恵みの年" (L), "主が恵みを示される年" (B, as LUK 4:19 B), "主が優しくしてくださる時" (R, near Luke R); yom naqam "復讐の日" (L; ISA-6), "報復される日" (B), "敵を罰する日" (R), the line Luke 4:19 leaves out (m3).
decisions.reason: Close to Luke where the Hebrew agrees; the settled word for vengeance.

decisions.choice: The chain of purpose infinitives runs from 61:1 through 61:3; L and B carry it with "……し、" across the verse markers and close it with "……ためである" in 61:3, keeping each verse's content after its own marker.
decisions.reason: Japanese puts the purpose word last.

source.text: לָשׂ֣וּם׀לַאֲבֵלֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן לָתֵת֩ לָהֶ֨ם פְּאֵ֜ר תַּ֣חַת אֵ֗פֶר שֶׁ֤מֶן שָׂשׂוֹן֙ תַּ֣חַת אֵ֔בֶל מַעֲטֵ֣ה תְהִלָּ֔ה תַּ֖חַת ר֣וּחַ כֵּהָ֑ה וְקֹרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ אֵילֵ֣י הַצֶּ֔דֶק מַטַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: to put for [the] mourners of Zion, to give to them a turban instead of ashes, oil of joy instead of mourning, a mantle of praise instead of a faint spirit; and it will be called to them oaks of righteousness, [the] planting of Yahweh, to glorify himself.

en.L: to provide for [the] mourners of Zion, to give them a turban instead of ashes, \q oil of joy instead of mourning, \q a wrap of praise instead of a dim spirit; \q and they will be called oaks of righteousness, \q the planting of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} beauty.
en.B: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give them a festive turban in place of ashes, \q the oil of rejoicing in place of grief, \q a cloak of praise in place of a spirit burning low. \q They will be named oaks of righteousness, \q planted by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} beauty.
en.R: He sent me to care for those in Zion who are mourning. \q They have ashes on their heads, but they will get a beautiful turban to wear. \q They are grieving, but they will receive oil that brings joy. \q Their spirits are weak, but they will be dressed in praise like a coat. \q People will call them great oak trees of righteousness. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} planted them to show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} beauty.

es.L: a proveer a los que lloran en Sion, a darles diadema en lugar de ceniza, \q aceite de gozo en lugar de luto, \q manto de alabanza en lugar de espíritu apagado; \q y serán llamados robles de justicia, \q plantío {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para mostrar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hermosura.
es.B: a proveer a los que están de luto en Sion, a darles un turbante de fiesta en lugar de ceniza, \q el aceite de la alegría en lugar del dolor, \q un manto de alabanza en lugar de un espíritu que se apaga. \q Serán llamados robles de justicia, \q plantados por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} para mostrar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hermosura.
es.R: Me envió a cuidar a los que están de luto en Sion. \q Tienen ceniza en la cabeza, pero recibirán un hermoso turbante para ponerse. \q Están llorando, pero recibirán aceite que trae alegría. \q Su espíritu está débil, pero serán vestidos de alabanza como de un abrigo. \q La gente los llamará grandes robles de justicia. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los plantó para mostrar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hermosura.

fr.L: pour accorder aux affligés de Sion, pour leur donner un turban au lieu de la cendre, \q l’huile de joie au lieu du deuil, \q un manteau de louange au lieu d’un esprit abattu ; \q et on les appellera chênes de justice, \q plantation {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour manifester {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} splendeur.
fr.B: pour prendre soin de ceux qui sont en deuil dans Sion, pour leur donner un turban de fête au lieu de la cendre, \q l’huile de l’allégresse au lieu du deuil, \q un manteau de louange au lieu d’un esprit qui s’éteint. \q On les appellera chênes de justice, \q plantés par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour manifester {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} splendeur.
fr.R: Il m’a envoyé prendre soin de ceux qui sont en deuil à Sion. \q Ils ont de la cendre sur la tête, mais ils recevront un beau turban à porter. \q Ils sont dans le deuil, mais ils recevront une huile qui donne la joie. \q Leur esprit est abattu, mais ils seront habillés de louange comme d’un manteau. \q On les appellera de grands chênes de justice. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a plantés pour montrer {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} splendeur.

sw.L: kuwapatia waombolezaji wa Sayuni, kuwapa kilemba badala ya majivu, \q mafuta ya furaha badala ya maombolezo, \q vazi la sifa badala ya roho iliyofifia; \q nao wataitwa mialoni ya haki, \q upandaji wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kuonyesha uzuri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: kuwahudumia wanaoomboleza katika Sayuni, kuwapa kilemba cha sherehe mahali pa majivu, \q mafuta ya shangwe mahali pa huzuni, \q joho la sifa mahali pa roho inayozimia. \q Wataitwa mialoni ya haki, \q iliyopandwa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kuonyesha uzuri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Alinituma kuwatunza wale walio katika Sayuni wanaoomboleza. \q Wana majivu vichwani mwao, lakini watapata kilemba kizuri cha kuvaa. \q Wana huzuni, lakini watapokea mafuta yanayoleta furaha. \q Roho zao ni dhaifu, lakini watavikwa sifa kama koti. \q Watu watawaita mialoni mikubwa ya haki. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapanda ili kuonyesha uzuri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: để chu cấp cho [những người] than khóc ở Si-ôn, để ban cho họ khăn đội đầu thay cho tro bụi, \q dầu vui mừng thay cho tang chế, \q áo choàng ca ngợi thay cho tâm linh tàn lụi; \q và họ sẽ được gọi là những cây sồi công chính, \q là cây {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã trồng, để bày tỏ vẻ huy hoàng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: để lo cho những người than khóc ở Si-ôn, ban cho họ khăn đội ngày lễ thay cho tro bụi, \q dầu hân hoan thay cho sầu thảm, \q áo choàng ca ngợi thay cho tâm linh tàn lụi. \q Họ sẽ được gọi là những cây sồi công chính, \q do {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trồng nên để bày tỏ vẻ huy hoàng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài đã sai tôi chăm sóc những người ở Si-ôn đang than khóc. \q Họ đang rắc tro trên đầu, nhưng họ sẽ được một chiếc khăn đội đầu thật đẹp. \q Họ đang sầu khổ, nhưng họ sẽ nhận được dầu đem lại niềm vui. \q Tâm hồn họ yếu đuối, nhưng họ sẽ được mặc sự ca ngợi như một chiếc áo khoác. \q Người ta sẽ gọi họ là những cây sồi lớn của sự công chính. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã trồng họ để bày tỏ vẻ huy hoàng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 시온에서 슬퍼하는 자들에게 [주게 하시고], 재 대신에 머리쓰개를, \q 슬픔 대신에 기쁨의 기름을, \q 꺼져 가는 영 대신에 찬양의 옷을 주게 하셨다. \q 그들은 의의 상수리나무, \q 그분의 아름다움을 드러내려고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 심으신 것이라고 불릴 것이다.
ko.B: 시온에서 슬퍼하는 사람들을 돌보아, 재 대신에 잔치의 머리쓰개를 씌우고, \q 슬픔 대신에 기쁨의 기름을 바르고, \q 꺼져 가는 마음 대신에 찬양의 겉옷을 입혀 주게 하셨다. \q 그들은 의의 상수리나무, \q 그분의 아름다움을 드러내려고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 심으신 나무라고 불릴 것이다.
ko.R: 그분이 나를 보내셔서 시온에서 슬퍼하는 사람들을 돌보게 하셨다. \q 그들은 머리에 재를 뒤집어쓰고 있지만, 머리에 쓸 아름다운 관을 받을 것이다. \q 그들은 슬퍼하고 있지만, 기쁨을 주는 기름을 받을 것이다. \q 그들의 마음은 약해져 있지만, 찬양을 겉옷처럼 입게 될 것이다. \q 사람들이 그들을 의의 커다란 상수리나무라고 부를 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 아름다움을 보이시려고 그들을 심으셨다.

pt.L: para prover aos que choram em Sião, para lhes dar um turbante em vez de cinza, \q óleo de alegria em vez de luto, \q um manto de louvor em vez de um espírito apagado; \q e serão chamados carvalhos de retidão, \q plantação {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para mostrar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} beleza.
pt.B: para cuidar dos que estão de luto em Sião, para lhes dar um turbante de festa no lugar da cinza, \q o óleo do júbilo no lugar da tristeza, \q uma capa de louvor no lugar de um espírito que se apaga. \q Eles serão chamados carvalhos de retidão, \q plantados {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}} para mostrar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} beleza.
pt.R: Ele me enviou para cuidar das pessoas de Sião que estão de luto. \q Elas têm cinza na cabeça, mas vão ganhar um belo turbante para usar. \q Estão tristes, mas vão receber um óleo que traz alegria. \q O espírito delas está fraco, mas vão ser vestidas de louvor como de um casaco. \q As pessoas vão chamá-las de grandes carvalhos de retidão. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} as plantou para mostrar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} beleza.

am.L: ለጽዮን አልቃሾች እሰጥ ዘንድ፣ በአመድ ፋንታ ጥምጥምን፣ \q በልቅሶ ፋንታ የደስታ ዘይትን፣ \q በከሰመ መንፈስ ፋንታ የምስጋና መጎናጸፊያን እሰጣቸው ዘንድ [ልኮኛል]፤ \q እነርሱም የጽድቅ ባሉጦች ይባላሉ፤ \q ውበቱን ያሳይ ዘንድ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተከላቸው [ተክል]።
am.B: በጽዮን የሚያለቅሱትን እንድረዳ፣ በአመድ ፋንታ የበዓል ጥምጥም እንድሰጣቸው፣ \q በሐዘን ፋንታ የደስታ ዘይት፣ \q በደከመ መንፈስ ፋንታም የምስጋና ካባ እንዳለብሳቸው ልኮኛል። \q የጽድቅ ባሉጦች ተብለው ይጠራሉ፤ \q ውበቱን ለማሳየት {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተከላቸው ናቸው።
am.R: በጽዮን ያሉትን የሚያለቅሱ ሰዎች እንድንከባከብ ልኮኛል። \q በራሳቸው ላይ አመድ አለ፤ ነገር ግን የሚያምር ጥምጥም ይጠመጥማሉ። \q ያዝናሉ፤ ነገር ግን ደስታን የሚያመጣ ዘይት ይቀበላሉ። \q መንፈሳቸው ደክሟል፤ ነገር ግን ምስጋናን እንደ ካባ ይለብሳሉ። \q ሰዎች የጽድቅ ታላላቅ ባሉጦች ብለው ይጠሯቸዋል። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ውበቱን ለማሳየት ተክሏቸዋል።

hi.L: कि सिय्योन के विलाप करनेवालों के लिए [प्रबंध] करूँ, कि उन्हें राख के बदले पगड़ी दूँ, \q विलाप के बदले आनंद का तेल, \q निर्बल आत्मा के बदले स्तुति का ओढ़ना; \q और वे धार्मिकता के बलूत कहलाएँगे, \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लगाए हुए, कि उनकी शोभा प्रकट हो।
hi.B: कि सिय्योन में शोक करनेवालों का प्रबंध करूँ, उन्हें राख के बदले उत्सव की पगड़ी दूँ, \q शोक के बदले हर्ष का तेल, \q बुझती हुई आत्मा के बदले स्तुति का चोगा। \q वे धार्मिकता के बलूत कहलाएँगे, \q जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी शोभा दिखाने के लिए लगाया है।
hi.R: उन्होंने मुझे भेजा है कि सिय्योन में शोक करनेवालों की देखभाल करूँ। \q उनके सिरों पर राख है, पर उन्हें पहनने को एक सुंदर पगड़ी मिलेगी। \q वे शोक कर रहे हैं, पर उन्हें ऐसा तेल मिलेगा जो आनंद लाता है। \q उनकी आत्मा निर्बल है, पर उन्हें स्तुति चोगे की तरह पहनाई जाएगी। \q लोग उन्हें धार्मिकता के विशाल बलूत के पेड़ कहेंगे। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उन्हें अपनी शोभा दिखाने के लिए लगाया है।

ru.L: дать скорбящим Сиона, дать им венец вместо пепла, \q елей радости вместо плача, \q покров хвалы вместо угасающего духа; \q и назовут их дубами праведности, \q насаждением {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, чтобы явить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} красу.
ru.B: позаботиться о тех, кто скорбит на Сионе, дать им праздничный венец вместо пепла, \q елей веселья вместо горя, \q одеяние хвалы вместо поникшего духа. \q Их назовут дубами праведности, \q которых посадил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, чтобы явить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} красу.
ru.R: Он послал меня позаботиться о тех, кто плачет на Сионе. \q У них на голове пепел, но они получат красивую повязку на голову. \q Они горюют, но получат масло, которое приносит радость. \q Их дух ослабел, но они оденутся хвалой, как плащом. \q Люди назовут их могучими дубами праведности. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} посадил их, чтобы показать свою красоту.

ja.L: シオンの嘆く者たちに[心を]配り、灰の代わりに頭飾りを、 \q 嘆きの代わりに喜びの油を、 \q くすぶる霊の代わりに賛美の外套を、彼らに与えるためである。 \q 彼らは義のテレビンの木、 \q ご自分の輝きを現すための{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の植えたものと呼ばれる。
ja.B: シオンで嘆く人々に心を配り、灰の代わりに晴れやかな頭飾りを、 \q 嘆きの代わりに喜びの油を、 \q 消えかけた霊の代わりに賛美の衣を与えるためである。 \q 彼らは義のテレビンの木と呼ばれる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の輝きを現すために植えられたものである。
ja.R: シオンで嘆き悲しんでいる人たちの世話をするために、わたしを遣わされた。 \q 彼らは頭に灰をかぶっているが、美しいかぶり物を着けるようになる。 \q 彼らは悲しんでいるが、喜びをもたらす油を受ける。 \q 彼らの心は弱っているが、賛美を上着のように着せられる。 \q 人々は彼らを、正しさを表す大きな木と呼ぶ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の輝きを現すために、彼らを植えられたのだ。

decisions.choice: a turban instead of ashes, oil of joy instead of mourning: the signs of mourning replaced by the dress of a celebration
decisions.reason: Mourners put ashes or dust on their heads (2 Samuel 13:19) and did not anoint themselves with oil (2 Samuel 14:2). At a feast people wore a fine headdress and put oil on their heads (Psalm 23:5; 45:8). The words for "turban" and "ashes" sound alike in Hebrew, and the same turban is worn by the bridegroom in verse 10.

decisions.choice: a dim spirit: a spirit that is faint and failing
decisions.reason: The word means dim or faint; it is used of the dimly burning wick in 42:3 and of failing eyes (Genesis 27:1).

decisions.choice: oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD: strong trees that God has planted, showing his beauty
decisions.reason: Oaks or terebinths are large, long-lived trees. In 1:29-30 the people were ashamed of the sacred oaks of idol worship; now they themselves are oaks marked by righteousness. "The planting of the LORD" and "to show his beauty" repeat 60:21. Grammar: the first verb in the verse ("to provide") has no object; the next phrase says what is given.

decisions.choice: They have ashes on their heads ... dressed in praise like a coat
decisions.reason: Readable spells out each exchange in short sentences and explains that the ashes were on their heads (see m1).

decisions.choice: um espírito apagado (L), que se apaga (B); carvalhos de retidão
decisions.reason: The word for the faint spirit is the one used of the dimly burning wick in 42:3 (m2), so Literal and Balanced keep the picture of a flame going out. Tsedeq is "retidão", the book's word (1:21); the line is worded apart from the familiar Portuguese versions of this passage, and "para mostrar a sua beleza" repeats 60:21 (m3).

decisions.choice: a turban instead of ashes "በአመድ ፋንታ ጥምጥም"; the wrap "መጎናጸፊያ" (L), "ካባ" (B, R); oaks "ባሉጦች"
decisions.reason: The headdress is the festive turban that replaces the ashes of mourning (meaning decision m1); the Hebrew sound-play of the two words cannot be kept in Amharic. "ባሉጥ" is the oak or terebinth, as in 1 Samuel 10:3 and 1 Chronicles 10:12. The passage was drafted fresh from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "बलूत" for the oaks
decisions.reason: The trees are great oaks or terebinths, strong trees God has planted (meaning m3); "बलूत" is the common Hindi word for the oak.

decisions.choice: "венец" (L, B); "красивую повязку на голову" (R)
decisions.reason: The headdress is a festive turban (m1); "венец" sounds in Russian, as the Hebrew does, close to "пепел" exchanged for beauty, and Readable describes it.

decisions.choice: 'elei hatsedeq "義のテレビンの木" (L, B), "正しさを表す大きな木" (R): 'elim keeps ISA-1's tree word (テレビンの木 L, B; 大きな木 R), and tsedeq is the righteousness God gives and plants (m3), 義 at L, B as ISA-6, so the phrase also stays clear of the familiar versions.
decisions.reason: The settled tree and righteousness words.

decisions.choice: pe'er "頭飾り" (L; 3:20), "晴れやかな頭飾り" (B), "かぶり物" (R); ruach kehah "くすぶる霊" (L), "消えかけた霊" (B), the kehah of 42:3 (くすぶる L, 消えかけた B); ma'teh "外套" (L), "衣" (B).
decisions.reason: Keeps the 42:3 echo of the dimly burning wick.

source.text: וּבָנוּ֙ חָרְב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם שֹׁמְמ֥וֹת רִֽאשֹׁנִ֖ים יְקוֹמֵ֑מוּ וְחִדְּשׁוּ֙ עָ֣רֵי חֹ֔רֶב שֹׁמְמ֖וֹת דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will build [the] ruins of antiquity; [the] desolations of [the] former [ones] they will raise up; and they will renew [the] cities of ruin, [the] desolations of generation and generation.

en.L: And they will build [the] ruins of long ago; \q [the] desolations of former [times] they will raise up; \q and they will renew [the] cities of ruin, \q [the] desolations of generation and generation.
en.B: They will build up what has lain in ruins since long ago \q and restore places left empty in their ancestors' time; \q they will make new again the wrecked cities, \q deserted for one generation after another.
en.R: They will rebuild the old ruins. \q They will repair places that were destroyed long ago. \q They will make the ruined towns new again, \q towns that have been empty for many years.

es.L: Y reedificarán las ruinas antiguas; \q las desolaciones de antaño levantarán; \q y renovarán las ciudades arruinadas, \q las desolaciones de generación y generación.
es.B: Reconstruirán lo que quedó en ruinas hace mucho \q y restaurarán los lugares que quedaron vacíos en tiempos de sus antepasados; \q renovarán las ciudades destruidas, \q abandonadas por una generación tras otra.
es.R: Reconstruirán las ruinas antiguas. \q Repararán los lugares que fueron destruidos hace mucho tiempo. \q Harán nuevos los pueblos arruinados, \q pueblos que han estado vacíos durante muchos años.

fr.L: Et ils bâtiront les ruines d’autrefois ; \q ils relèveront les dévastations des anciens [temps] ; \q et ils renouvelleront les villes en ruine, \q les dévastations de génération en génération.
fr.B: Ils rebâtiront ce qui est en ruine depuis longtemps \q et relèveront les lieux dévastés au temps de leurs ancêtres ; \q ils remettront à neuf les villes détruites, \q désertes depuis des générations.
fr.R: Ils reconstruiront les vieilles ruines. \q Ils répareront les endroits détruits il y a longtemps. \q Ils rendront neuves les villes en ruine, \q des villes vides depuis bien des années.

sw.L: Nao watajenga magofu ya zamani; \q mahali palipokuwa ukiwa pa [nyakati za] kwanza wataviinua; \q nao wataifanya upya miji ya uharibifu, \q mahali palipokuwa ukiwa kizazi hata kizazi.
sw.B: Watajenga yale yaliyokaa magofu tangu zamani \q na kurejesha mahali palipoachwa tupu wakati wa babu zao; \q wataifanya upya miji iliyoharibiwa, \q iliyoachwa tupu kizazi kimoja baada ya kingine.
sw.R: Watajenga upya magofu ya zamani. \q Watatengeneza mahali palipoharibiwa zamani sana. \q Wataifanya upya miji iliyoharibiwa, \q miji ambayo imekuwa tupu kwa miaka mingi.

vi.L: Và họ sẽ xây lại những nơi đổ nát xưa; \q họ sẽ dựng lại những nơi hoang tàn của [thời] trước; \q và họ sẽ làm mới lại những thành đổ nát, \q những nơi hoang tàn của đời này qua đời kia.
vi.B: Họ sẽ xây lại những gì đã đổ nát từ lâu \q và dựng lại những nơi bị bỏ hoang từ thời tổ tiên; \q họ sẽ làm mới lại những thành bị tàn phá, \q bỏ hoang hết thế hệ này đến thế hệ khác.
vi.R: Họ sẽ xây lại những nơi đổ nát xưa. \q Họ sẽ sửa lại những nơi đã bị phá hủy từ lâu. \q Họ sẽ làm mới lại những thành bị tàn phá, \q những thành đã bỏ trống nhiều năm.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 오래된 폐허를 쌓고, \q 옛 황폐한 곳들을 일으키며, \q 무너진 성읍들, \q 대대로 황폐했던 곳들을 새롭게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 오래전부터 무너져 있던 곳들을 다시 세우고, \q 조상 때부터 버려진 곳들을 일으킬 것이다. \q 그들은 무너진 성읍들, \q 대대로 버려져 있던 곳들을 새롭게 할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 오래된 폐허를 다시 세울 것이다. \q 오래전에 파괴된 곳들을 고칠 것이다. \q 무너진 성읍들을 새롭게 할 것이다. \q 그 성읍들은 여러 해 동안 비어 있었다.

pt.L: E reconstruirão as ruínas antigas; \q as desolações dos antigos levantarão; \q e renovarão as cidades em ruína, \q as desolações de geração e geração.
pt.B: Eles vão reconstruir o que está em ruínas desde muito tempo atrás \q e restaurar os lugares que ficaram vazios no tempo dos antepassados; \q vão renovar as cidades arrasadas, \q desertas por uma geração após outra.
pt.R: Eles vão reconstruir as ruínas antigas. \q Vão consertar lugares destruídos há muito tempo. \q Vão deixar como novas as cidades arruinadas, \q cidades que estão vazias há muitos anos.

am.L: የጥንቱንም ፍርስራሽ ይሠራሉ፤ \q የቀድሞውንም ባድማ ያቆማሉ፤ \q የፈረሱትንም ከተሞች ያድሳሉ፤ \q የትውልድና የትውልድ ባድማዎችን [ያድሳሉ]።
am.B: ከጥንት ጀምሮ ፈርሶ የኖረውን መልሰው ይሠራሉ፤ \q በአባቶቻቸው ዘመን ባዶ የቀሩትን ስፍራዎች ያቆማሉ፤ \q የወደሙትን ከተሞች፣ \q ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ባድማ ሆነው የኖሩትን እንደ ገና ያድሳሉ።
am.R: የጥንቱን ፍርስራሽ መልሰው ይሠራሉ። \q ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት የፈረሱትን ስፍራዎች ይጠግናሉ። \q የፈረሱትን ከተሞች እንደ ገና አዲስ ያደርጋሉ። \q እነዚህ ከተሞች ለብዙ ዓመታት ባዶ ሆነው ቆይተዋል።

hi.L: और वे प्राचीन काल के खंडहरों को बनाएँगे; \q पहले [समय] के उजाड़ स्थानों को वे खड़ा करेंगे; \q और वे उजड़े हुए नगरों को नया करेंगे, \q पीढ़ी-पीढ़ी के उजाड़ स्थानों को।
hi.B: वे उन्हें फिर से बनाएँगे जो बहुत समय से खंडहर पड़े हैं, \q और उन स्थानों को फिर खड़ा करेंगे जो उनके पूर्वजों के समय में सूने हो गए थे; \q वे उजड़े हुए नगरों को फिर से नया करेंगे, \q जो पीढ़ी के बाद पीढ़ी सूने पड़े रहे।
hi.R: वे पुराने खंडहरों को फिर से बनाएँगे। \q वे उन जगहों की मरम्मत करेंगे जो बहुत पहले नष्ट हो गई थीं। \q वे उजड़े हुए नगरों को फिर से नया बनाएँगे, \q ऐसे नगर जो बहुत वर्षों से सूने पड़े हैं।

ru.L: И отстроят они развалины древности; \q опустошения прежних [времён] восстановят; \q и обновят города разорения, \q опустошения рода и рода.
ru.B: Они отстроят то, что лежит в развалинах с давних времён, \q и восстановят места, опустевшие ещё при их предках; \q они обновят разорённые города, \q пустовавшие из поколения в поколение.
ru.R: Они отстроят старые развалины. \q Они восстановят места, разрушенные давным-давно. \q Они сделают разорённые города снова новыми, \q города, которые много лет стояли пустыми.

ja.L: 彼らは、昔からの廃墟を建て直し、 \q 先の時代の荒れ跡を復興し、 \q 廃墟の町々を新しくする、 \q 代々の荒れ跡を。
ja.B: 彼らは、遠い昔からの廃墟を建て直し、 \q 先祖の時代に荒れ果てた所を復興し、 \q 破壊された町々を新しくする、 \q 幾世代にもわたって荒れ果てていた町々を。
ja.R: 彼らは、古い廃墟を建て直す。 \q ずっと昔に壊された所を修理する。 \q 荒れ果てた町々を、新しくする。 \q 長い間、だれも住んでいなかった町々だ。

decisions.choice: they: the mourners of Zion, now restored
decisions.reason: The people who were mourning in verse 3 are the ones who rebuild. In verse 5 foreigners serve them.

decisions.choice: rebuilding the ancient ruins: the promise of 58:12 and 49:8
decisions.reason: In 58:12 those who keep God's ways "will build the ancient ruins". The promise answers 44:26, where God says of Judah's towns, "they will be rebuilt" (compare Amos 9:14).

decisions.choice: reconstruirão as ruínas antigas
decisions.reason: The promise repeats 58:12 (m2), so Literal uses that verse's Portuguese words.

decisions.choice: uvanu chorvot 'olam "昔からの廃墟を建て直し" (L), the same words as 58:12 L (m2).
decisions.reason: One wording for the repeated promise.

source.text: וְעָמְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים וְרָע֖וּ צֹאנְכֶ֑ם וּבְנֵ֣י נֵכָ֔ר אִכָּרֵיכֶ֖ם וְכֹרְמֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And strangers will stand and shepherd your flocks, and sons of foreignness [will be] your farmers and your vinedressers.

en.L: And strangers will stand and shepherd your flocks, \q and sons of a foreign land [will be] your plowmen and your vinedressers.
en.B: Outsiders will stand ready to pasture your flocks, \q and people from foreign lands will plow your fields and tend your vines.
en.R: People from other countries will come and take care of your sheep. \q Foreigners will plow your fields and take care of your grapevines.

es.L: Y extranjeros se presentarán y apacentarán {{plural_you:sus rebaños|vuestros rebaños}}, \q e hijos de extranjeros [serán] {{plural_you:sus labradores y sus viñadores|vuestros labradores y vuestros viñadores}}.
es.B: Gente de fuera estará lista para apacentar {{plural_you:sus rebaños|vuestros rebaños}}, \q y gente de tierras extranjeras arará {{plural_you:sus campos y cuidará sus viñas|vuestros campos y cuidará vuestras viñas}}.
es.R: Gente de otros países vendrá a cuidar {{plural_you:sus ovejas|vuestras ovejas}}. \q Los extranjeros ararán {{plural_you:sus campos y cuidarán sus viñas|vuestros campos y cuidarán vuestras viñas}}.

fr.L: Et des étrangers se tiendront là et feront paître vos troupeaux, \q et des fils de l’étranger [seront] vos laboureurs et vos vignerons.
fr.B: Des étrangers seront prêts à faire paître vos troupeaux, \q et des gens d’autres pays laboureront vos champs et soigneront vos vignes.
fr.R: Des gens d’autres pays viendront s’occuper de vos moutons. \q Des étrangers laboureront vos champs et prendront soin de vos vignes.

sw.L: Na wageni watasimama na kulisha makundi yenu, \q na wana wa nchi ya kigeni [watakuwa] wakulima wenu na watunza mizabibu wenu.
sw.B: Watu wa nje watasimama tayari kuchunga makundi yenu, \q na watu kutoka nchi za kigeni watalima mashamba yenu na kutunza mizabibu yenu.
sw.R: Watu kutoka nchi nyingine watakuja kuwatunzia kondoo wenu. \q Wageni watalima mashamba yenu na kutunza mizabibu yenu.

vi.L: Và người lạ sẽ đứng chăn bầy chiên của các ngươi, \q và con cái của đất ngoại bang [sẽ là] người cày ruộng và người trồng nho của các ngươi.
vi.B: Người ngoại sẽ sẵn sàng chăn bầy chiên của các ngươi, \q và người từ đất ngoại bang sẽ cày ruộng và chăm sóc vườn nho của các ngươi.
vi.R: Người từ các nước khác sẽ đến chăn chiên cho các ngươi. \q Người ngoại quốc sẽ cày ruộng và chăm sóc vườn nho cho các ngươi.

ko.L: 그리고 낯선 사람들이 서서 너희의 양 떼를 칠 것이고, \q 이방 사람들이 너희의 농부와 포도원 일꾼이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 낯선 사람들이 와서 너희의 양 떼를 치고, \q 이방 사람들이 너희의 밭을 갈고 포도나무를 가꿀 것이다.
ko.R: 다른 나라 사람들이 와서 너희의 양들을 돌볼 것이다. \q 외국 사람들이 너희의 밭을 갈고 너희의 포도나무를 가꿀 것이다.

pt.L: E estrangeiros estarão de pé e apascentarão os rebanhos de vocês, \q e filhos de terra estrangeira [serão] os seus lavradores e os seus vinhateiros.
pt.B: Estranhos estarão prontos para pastorear os rebanhos de vocês, \q e gente de terras estrangeiras vai arar os seus campos e cuidar das suas videiras.
pt.R: Gente de outros países virá cuidar das ovelhas de vocês. \q Estrangeiros vão arar os campos de vocês e cuidar das suas parreiras.

am.L: እንግዶችም ቆመው መንጎቻችሁን ያሰማራሉ፤ \q የባዕድ አገር ልጆችም አራሾቻችሁና ወይን ተካዮቻችሁ [ይሆናሉ]።
am.B: የውጭ ሰዎች መንጎቻችሁን ለማሰማራት ተዘጋጅተው ይቆማሉ፤ \q የባዕድ አገር ሰዎችም እርሻችሁን ያርሳሉ፤ ወይናችሁንም ይንከባከባሉ።
am.R: የሌሎች አገሮች ሰዎች መጥተው በጎቻችሁን ይጠብቃሉ። \q የውጭ አገር ሰዎች እርሻችሁን ያርሳሉ፤ የወይን ተክሎቻችሁንም ይንከባከባሉ።

hi.L: और परदेशी खड़े होकर तुम्हारी भेड़-बकरियाँ चराएँगे, \q और परदेश के पुत्र तुम्हारे हलवाहे और तुम्हारी दाख की बारियों के माली [होंगे]।
hi.B: परदेशी तुम्हारे झुंडों को चराने के लिए तैयार खड़े रहेंगे, \q और परदेश के लोग तुम्हारे खेत जोतेंगे और तुम्हारी दाखलताओं की देखभाल करेंगे।
hi.R: दूसरे देशों के लोग आकर तुम्हारी भेड़ों की देखभाल करेंगे। \q परदेशी तुम्हारे खेत जोतेंगे और तुम्हारी अंगूर की बेलों की देखभाल करेंगे।

ru.L: И встанут чужие и будут пасти ваши стада, \q и сыны чужбины [будут] вашими пахарями и вашими виноградарями.
ru.B: Чужеземцы будут готовы пасти ваши стада, \q а люди из чужих земель будут пахать ваши поля и ухаживать за вашими виноградниками.
ru.R: Люди из других стран придут и будут заботиться о ваших овцах. \q Иноземцы будут пахать ваши поля и ухаживать за вашими виноградниками.

ja.L: よそ者たちが立って、あなたがたの羊の群れを飼い、 \q 異国の子らが、あなたがたの農夫、ぶどう園の働き手となる。
ja.B: 異国の者たちが待ち構えて、あなたがたの羊の群れを飼い、 \q 外国の人々が、あなたがたの畑を耕し、ぶどうの木の手入れをする。
ja.R: 外国人が来て、あなたたちの羊の世話をする。 \q 外国の人々が、あなたたちの畑を耕し、ぶどうの木の世話をする。

decisions.choice: your: now plural, addressed to the people of Zion
decisions.reason: From here to verse 7 the people are addressed as "you" (plural), not the city as "you" (feminine singular) as in chapter 60.

decisions.choice: foreigners doing the work: the people freed to serve God as priests
decisions.reason: Once strangers devoured the land (1:7); now they tend its flocks and fields. This frees Israel for the priestly work of verse 6 (compare 14:2; 60:10).

decisions.choice: vocês (verses 5-7)
decisions.reason: Here "you" is plural, the people of Zion, not the city addressed as a woman (m1), so Portuguese says "vocês", as God speaks to a group.

decisions.choice: "your" as the plural "-ችሁ" (መንጎቻችሁን, እርሻችሁን) from here to the end of the chapter
decisions.reason: The Hebrew now speaks to the people of Zion in the plural (meaning decision m1), and Amharic shows the change in every suffix, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "तुम्हारी" for the plural you
