source.text: וְאַתֶּ֗ם כֹּהֲנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ תִּקָּרֵ֔אוּ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ יֵאָמֵ֖ר לָכֶ֑ם חֵ֤יל גּוֹיִם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וּבִכְבוֹדָ֖ם תִּתְיַמָּֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, priests of Yahweh you will be called; servants of our God it will be said of you; [the] wealth of nations you will eat, and in their glory you will boast.

en.L: But you, [the] priests of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} you will be called; \q servants of our God it will be said of you; \q [the] wealth of nations you will eat, \q and in their glory you will boast.
en.B: And you will be known as priests of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q people will speak of you as those who serve our God. \q You will live on the wealth of the nations \q and take pride in their glory.
en.R: You will be called priests of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q People will say that you serve our God. \q You will enjoy the riches of the nations, \q and their glory will make you proud.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes serán llamados|vosotros seréis llamados}} sacerdotes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q ministros de nuestro Dios se {{plural_you:les|os}} dirá; \q la riqueza de las naciones {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}}, \q y en su gloria se {{plural_you:gloriarán|gloriaréis}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes serán conocidos|Vosotros seréis conocidos}} como sacerdotes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q la gente hablará de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como los que sirven a nuestro Dios. \q {{plural_you:Vivirán|Viviréis}} de la riqueza de las naciones \q y se {{plural_you:enorgullecerán|enorgulleceréis}} de su gloria.
es.R: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} llamarán sacerdotes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q La gente dirá que {{plural_you:ustedes sirven|vosotros servís}} a nuestro Dios. \q {{plural_you:Disfrutarán|Disfrutaréis}} de las riquezas de las naciones, \q y su gloria {{plural_you:los llenará|os llenará}} de orgullo.

fr.L: Mais vous, prêtres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, on vous appellera ; \q serviteurs de notre Dieu, on dira de vous ; \q la richesse des nations, vous la mangerez, \q et de leur gloire vous vous vanterez.
fr.B: Et vous, on vous appellera prêtres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q on dira de vous que vous êtes au service de notre Dieu. \q Vous vivrez de la richesse des nations \q et vous serez fiers de leur gloire.
fr.R: On vous appellera prêtres {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Les gens diront que vous servez notre Dieu. \q Vous profiterez des richesses des nations, \q et leur gloire vous rendra fiers.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi, mtaitwa makuhani wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q watumishi wa Mungu wetu mtasemwa; \q utajiri wa mataifa mtakula, \q na katika utukufu wao mtajivunia.
sw.B: Nanyi mtajulikana kama makuhani wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q watu watawataja kuwa wale wanaomtumikia Mungu wetu. \q Mtaishi kwa utajiri wa mataifa \q na kujivunia utukufu wao.
sw.R: Mtaitwa makuhani wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Watu watasema kwamba mnamtumikia Mungu wetu. \q Mtafurahia utajiri wa mataifa, \q na utukufu wao utawafanya mjivune.

vi.L: Nhưng các ngươi, các ngươi sẽ được gọi là [những] thầy tế lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q người ta sẽ gọi các ngươi là đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta; \q các ngươi sẽ ăn của cải các dân tộc, \q và các ngươi sẽ tự hào trong vinh quang của họ.
vi.B: Còn các ngươi sẽ được gọi là thầy tế lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q người ta sẽ nói về các ngươi như những người phục vụ Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta. \q Các ngươi sẽ sống nhờ của cải các dân tộc \q và hãnh diện về vinh quang của họ.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ được gọi là thầy tế lễ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Người ta sẽ nói rằng các ngươi phục vụ Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta. \q Các ngươi sẽ hưởng của cải của các dân tộc, \q và vinh quang của họ sẽ làm cho các ngươi hãnh diện.

ko.L: 그러나 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제사장이라 불리고, \q 사람들이 너희를 우리 하나님의 일꾼이라 말할 것이다. \q 너희는 민족들의 재물을 먹고, \q 그들의 영광을 자랑할 것이다.
ko.B: 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제사장이라 불리고, \q 사람들은 너희를 우리 하나님을 섬기는 이들이라고 말할 것이다. \q 너희는 민족들의 재물로 살고, \q 그들의 영광을 자랑으로 삼을 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제사장이라고 불릴 것이다. \q 사람들은 너희가 우리 하나님을 섬긴다고 말할 것이다. \q 너희는 민족들의 재물을 누릴 것이다. \q 그들의 영광이 너희를 자랑스럽게 할 것이다.

pt.L: Mas vocês, sacerdotes {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} serão chamados; \q servos do nosso Deus se dirá de vocês; \q a riqueza das nações vocês comerão, \q e na glória delas vocês se gloriarão.
pt.B: E vocês serão conhecidos como sacerdotes {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; \q falarão de vocês como os que servem o nosso Deus. \q Vocês viverão da riqueza das nações \q e terão orgulho da glória delas.
pt.R: Vocês serão chamados sacerdotes {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. \q As pessoas vão dizer que vocês servem o nosso Deus. \q Vocês vão aproveitar as riquezas das nações, \q e a glória delas vai deixar vocês orgulhosos.

am.L: እናንተ ግን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ካህናት ትባላላችሁ፤ \q የአምላካችን አገልጋዮች ይሏችኋል፤ \q የሕዝቦችን ሀብት ትበላላችሁ፤ \q በክብራቸውም ትመካላችሁ።
am.B: እናንተም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ካህናት ተብላችሁ ትታወቃላችሁ፤ \q ሰዎችም አምላካችንን የምታገለግሉ ብለው ይጠሯችኋል። \q በሕዝቦች ሀብት ትኖራላችሁ፤ \q በክብራቸውም ትኮራላችሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ካህናት ትባላላችሁ። \q ሰዎች አምላካችንን የምታገለግሉ እንደ ሆናችሁ ይናገራሉ። \q በሕዝቦች ሀብት ትደሰታላችሁ፤ \q ክብራቸውም ያኮራችኋል።

hi.L: पर तुम, तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के याजक कहलाओगे; \q हमारे परमेश्वर के सेवक, तुम्हारे विषय में यह कहा जाएगा; \q तुम जातियों का धन खाओगे, \q और उनकी महिमा पर तुम गर्व करोगे।
hi.B: तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के याजक कहलाओगे; \q लोग तुम्हारे विषय में कहेंगे कि ये हमारे परमेश्वर की सेवा करनेवाले हैं। \q तुम देशों के धन पर जीवन बिताओगे \q और उनकी महिमा पर गर्व करोगे।
hi.R: तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के याजक कहलाओगे। \q लोग कहेंगे कि तुम हमारे परमेश्वर की सेवा करते हो। \q तुम राष्ट्रों के धन का आनंद लोगे, \q और उनकी महिमा से तुम्हें गर्व होगा।

ru.L: А вы — священниками {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} назовётесь; \q служителями нашего Бога будут называть вас; \q достояние народов будете есть \q и их славой будете хвалиться.
ru.B: А вас будут знать как священников {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; \q о вас будут говорить как о служителях нашего Бога. \q Вы будете жить богатством народов \q и гордиться их славой.
ru.R: Вас назовут священниками {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. \q Люди будут говорить, что вы служите нашему Богу. \q Вы будете пользоваться богатствами народов, \q и их слава будет предметом вашей гордости.

ja.L: しかし、あなたがたは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の祭司と呼ばれ、 \q わたしたちの神に仕える者と言われる。 \q あなたがたは国々の富を食べ、 \q その栄光を誇る。
ja.B: あなたがたは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の祭司として知られ、 \q わたしたちの神に仕える者と呼ばれる。 \q 国々の富によって暮らし、 \q その栄光を誇りとする。
ja.R: あなたたちは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の祭司と呼ばれる。 \q 人々は、あなたたちがわたしたちの神に仕えていると言う。 \q あなたたちは国々の富を楽しみ、 \q その栄光を誇りとする。

decisions.choice: priests of the LORD: the whole people serving God as priests among the nations
decisions.reason: At Sinai God called Israel "a kingdom of priests" (Exodus 19:6). The promise is taken up for the church in 1 Peter 2:9 and Revelation 1:6; 5:10. In 66:21 God takes some even from the nations as priests.

decisions.choice: in their glory you will boast: you will take pride in the riches of the nations
alternatives: you will take over their glory
decisions.reason: "Glory" here means wealth and splendor, as in 66:12. The verb is rare; it is usually taken as "boast" (Psalm 94:4). It may instead come from a verb meaning "exchange", giving "you will take over their glory".

decisions.choice: "सेवक", not "दास"
decisions.reason: The word is the one for those who minister at the sanctuary, set beside "priests" (meaning m1), not the word for a slave; "सेवक" is kept for service, as the Pentateuch note allows where service alone is the point.

decisions.choice: "служителями" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The word here is a participle of "serve", used of ministers in the temple, not ʿeved; "служители" sets it beside "священники".

decisions.choice: titymmaru "誇る" (L), "誇りとする" (B, R), the reading of m2 (uncertain; the footnote gives the alternatives).
decisions.reason: Follows the meaning decision.

source.text: תַּ֤חַת בָּשְׁתְּכֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה וּכְלִמָּ֖ה יָרֹ֣נּוּ חֶלְקָ֑ם לָכֵ֤ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֣ה יִירָ֔שׁוּ שִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Instead of your shame, double; and [instead of] disgrace they will shout for joy [over] their portion; therefore in their land double they will possess; joy of perpetuity will be to them.

en.L: In place of your shame, double; \q and [in place of] disgrace they will shout for joy [over] their share; \q therefore in their land double they will possess; \q joy forever will be theirs.
en.B: In place of your shame you will have a double share; \q instead of disgrace they will sing out over what is given them. \q So in their own land they will take possession of a double share, \q and joy that never ends will belong to them.
en.R: You were put to shame, but now you will receive twice as much. \q You were disgraced, but now they will shout for joy over what they receive. \q In their land they will receive twice as much as before. \q Their joy will last forever.

es.L: En lugar de {{plural_you:su vergüenza|vuestra vergüenza}}, el doble; \q y [en lugar de] la afrenta gritarán de júbilo [por] su porción; \q por tanto, en su tierra poseerán el doble; \q gozo eterno tendrán.
es.B: En lugar de {{plural_you:su vergüenza tendrán|vuestra vergüenza tendréis}} doble porción; \q en lugar de la afrenta cantarán de alegría por lo que se les da. \q Así, en su propia tierra recibirán una doble porción, \q y una alegría sin fin será suya.
es.R: {{plural_you:Fueron avergonzados|Fuisteis avergonzados}}, pero ahora {{plural_you:recibirán|recibiréis}} el doble. \q {{plural_you:Fueron deshonrados|Fuisteis deshonrados}}, pero ahora ellos gritarán de alegría por lo que reciben. \q En su tierra recibirán el doble de lo que tenían antes. \q Su alegría durará para siempre.

fr.L: Au lieu de votre honte, le double ; \q et [au lieu de] l’opprobre, ils crieront de joie [sur] leur part ; \q c’est pourquoi dans leur pays ils posséderont le double ; \q une joie éternelle sera à eux.
fr.B: Au lieu de votre honte, vous aurez une double part ; \q au lieu de l’humiliation, ils chanteront de joie pour ce qu’ils recevront. \q Ainsi, dans leur pays, ils posséderont une double part, \q et une joie sans fin leur appartiendra.
fr.R: Vous avez été couverts de honte, mais maintenant vous recevrez deux fois plus. \q Vous avez été humiliés, mais maintenant ils crieront de joie pour ce qu’ils recevront. \q Dans leur pays, ils recevront deux fois plus qu’avant. \q Leur joie durera toujours.

sw.L: Badala ya aibu yenu, maradufu; \q na [badala ya] fedheha watashangilia [juu ya] fungu lao; \q kwa hiyo katika nchi yao watamiliki maradufu; \q furaha ya milele itakuwa yao.
sw.B: Badala ya aibu yenu mtapata fungu maradufu; \q badala ya fedheha wataimba kwa shangwe juu ya kile walichopewa. \q Kwa hiyo katika nchi yao wenyewe watamiliki fungu maradufu, \q na furaha isiyokoma itakuwa yao.
sw.R: Mlitiwa aibu, lakini sasa mtapokea mara mbili zaidi. \q Mlifedheheshwa, lakini sasa watashangilia kwa furaha juu ya wanachopokea. \q Katika nchi yao watapokea mara mbili zaidi ya hapo kwanza. \q Furaha yao itadumu milele.

vi.L: Thay cho sự hổ thẹn của các ngươi, [có] gấp đôi; \q và [thay cho] sự nhục nhã, họ sẽ reo vui [về] phần của mình; \q vì thế trong xứ mình họ sẽ chiếm hữu gấp đôi; \q niềm vui đời đời sẽ thuộc về họ.
vi.B: Thay cho nỗi hổ thẹn, các ngươi sẽ được phần gấp đôi; \q thay cho sự nhục nhã, họ sẽ reo mừng về phần mình nhận được. \q Vì thế trong xứ mình họ sẽ nhận phần gấp đôi, \q và niềm vui bất tận sẽ thuộc về họ.
vi.R: Các ngươi đã bị hổ thẹn, nhưng bây giờ các ngươi sẽ nhận gấp đôi. \q Các ngươi đã bị nhục nhã, nhưng bây giờ họ sẽ reo vui về những gì họ nhận được. \q Trong xứ mình họ sẽ nhận gấp đôi so với trước. \q Niềm vui của họ sẽ còn mãi mãi.

ko.L: 너희의 수치 대신에 갑절을 [받고], \q 모욕 대신에 그들이 자기 몫으로 기뻐 외칠 것이다. \q 그러므로 그들이 자기 땅에서 갑절을 차지하고, \q 영원한 기쁨이 그들의 것이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 너희는 수치를 당한 대신에 갑절의 몫을 받고, \q 그들은 모욕을 당한 대신에 자기 몫을 받고 기뻐 노래할 것이다. \q 그래서 그들은 자기 땅에서 갑절의 몫을 차지하고, \q 끝없는 기쁨이 그들의 것이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 수치를 당했지만, 이제는 두 배를 받을 것이다. \q 너희는 모욕을 당했지만, 이제 그들은 자기가 받은 몫 때문에 기뻐 외칠 것이다. \q 그들은 자기 땅에서 전보다 두 배를 받을 것이다. \q 그들의 기쁨은 영원할 것이다.

pt.L: Em lugar da vergonha de vocês, o dobro; \q e [em lugar da] humilhação, eles gritarão de alegria [pela] sua porção; \q por isso na terra deles possuirão o dobro; \q alegria eterna será deles.
pt.B: Em lugar da vergonha, vocês terão porção dobrada; \q em vez da humilhação, eles vão cantar de alegria pelo que receberem. \q Por isso na sua própria terra tomarão posse de porção dobrada, \q e uma alegria que nunca acaba será deles.
pt.R: Vocês passaram vergonha, mas agora vão receber o dobro. \q Vocês foram humilhados, mas agora eles vão gritar de alegria pelo que recebem. \q Na sua terra vão receber o dobro do que tinham antes. \q A alegria deles vai durar para sempre.

am.L: በእፍረታችሁ ፋንታ እጥፍ [ይሆንላችኋል]፤ \q በውርደትም ፋንታ በድርሻቸው እልል ይላሉ፤ \q ስለዚህ በምድራቸው እጥፍ ይወርሳሉ፤ \q የዘላለም ደስታ ለእነርሱ ይሆናል።
am.B: በእፍረታችሁ ፋንታ እጥፍ ድርሻ ይኖራችኋል፤ \q በውርደት ፋንታ በተሰጣቸው ድርሻ እልል ይላሉ። \q ስለዚህ በገዛ ምድራቸው እጥፍ ድርሻ ይወርሳሉ፤ \q የማያልቅ ደስታም የእነርሱ ይሆናል።
am.R: አፍራችሁ ነበር፤ አሁን ግን እጥፍ ትቀበላላችሁ። \q ተዋርዳችሁ ነበር፤ አሁን ግን በሚቀበሉት ነገር እልል ይላሉ። \q በምድራቸው ከበፊቱ እጥፍ ይቀበላሉ። \q ደስታቸው ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: तुम्हारी लज्जा के बदले दुगुना; \q और अपमान के [बदले] वे अपने भाग [पर] जयजयकार करेंगे; \q इसलिए अपने देश में वे दुगुने के अधिकारी होंगे; \q सदा का आनंद उनका होगा।
hi.B: तुम्हारी लज्जा के बदले तुम्हें दुगुना भाग मिलेगा; \q अपमान के बदले वे अपने मिले हुए भाग पर आनंद से गाएँगे। \q इसलिए अपने ही देश में वे दुगुने भाग के अधिकारी होंगे, \q और कभी न समाप्त होनेवाला आनंद उनका होगा।
hi.R: तुम्हें लज्जित किया गया था, पर अब तुम्हें दुगुना मिलेगा। \q तुम्हारा अपमान हुआ था, पर अब वे अपने मिले हुए भाग पर आनंद से जयजयकार करेंगे। \q अपने देश में उन्हें पहले से दुगुना मिलेगा। \q उनका आनंद सदा बना रहेगा।

ru.L: Вместо вашего стыда — вдвое, \q и [вместо] позора будут ликовать они [о] своей доле; \q поэтому в своей земле вдвое они получат во владение; \q радость вечная будет им.
ru.B: Вместо стыда вы получите двойную долю; \q вместо позора они будут ликовать о своём уделе. \q Поэтому в своей земле они получат двойную долю, \q и радость, которой нет конца, будет принадлежать им.
ru.R: Вас позорили, но теперь вы получите вдвое больше. \q Вас унижали, но теперь они будут радостно кричать о том, что получат. \q В своей земле они получат вдвое больше, чем прежде. \q Их радость будет вечной.

ja.L: あなたがたの恥の代わりに、二倍のもの[を受け]、 \q 辱めの代わりに、彼らは自分の分け前を喜び歌う。 \q それゆえ、彼らは自分の地で二倍のものを所有し、 \q とこしえの喜びが彼らのものとなる。
ja.B: 恥の代わりに、あなたがたは二倍の分を受け、 \q 辱めの代わりに、彼らは与えられた分を喜び歌う。 \q それゆえ、彼らは自分の地で二倍の分を所有し、 \q 尽きることのない喜びが彼らのものとなる。
ja.R: あなたたちは恥を受けたが、今度は二倍のものを受け取る。 \q 辱められたが、今度は、自分たちが受け取るものを喜んで叫ぶ。 \q 彼らは自分の地で、以前の二倍のものを受け取る。 \q 彼らの喜びは、いつまでも続く。

decisions.choice: double: a double share, like the portion of a firstborn son
decisions.reason: The firstborn received a double share of the inheritance (Deuteronomy 21:17). In 40:2 Jerusalem received double for her sins; now she receives double in blessing.

decisions.choice: your ... they: the verse moves from "you" to "they" without warning
decisions.reason: Hebrew poetry often changes person in this way; both refer to the people of Zion. The lines are short and leave words to be supplied: "instead of" carries over to "disgrace".

decisions.choice: twice as much; twice as much as before
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "double" means.

decisions.choice: the change from "तुम्हारी" to "वे" kept
decisions.reason: The verse moves from "you" to "they" without warning (meaning m2); Hindi keeps the shift at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "вашего ... они"
decisions.reason: The verse moves from "you" to "they" without warning (m2); every level keeps the change, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The verse moves from "your" to "they" without warning (m2); every level keeps the change ("あなたがた / あなたたち" … "彼ら") rather than smoothing it.
decisions.reason: The English keeps it too.

source.text: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֹהֵ֣ב מִשְׁפָּ֔ט שֹׂנֵ֥א גָזֵ֖ל בְּעוֹלָ֑ה וְנָתַתִּ֤י פְעֻלָּתָם֙ בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת וּבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם אֶכְר֥וֹת לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For I Yahweh [am] loving justice, hating robbery with injustice; and I will give their wage in faithfulness, and a covenant of perpetuity I will make with them.

en.L: For I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, love justice; \q I hate robbery with wrongdoing; \q and I will give their wages in faithfulness, \q and a covenant forever I will make with them.
en.B: For I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, am a lover of justice \q and I hate robbery joined to wrongdoing. \q I will pay them their wages faithfully \q and make a covenant with them that lasts forever.
en.R: I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, love what is fair. \q I hate stealing and every kind of wrong. \q I will be faithful and give {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people what they have earned. \q I will make a covenant with them that will last forever.

es.L: Porque yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, amo el derecho; \q aborrezco el robo con iniquidad; \q y les daré su recompensa con fidelidad, \q y un pacto eterno haré con ellos.
es.B: Porque yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, amo la justicia \q y aborrezco el robo unido a la maldad. \q Les pagaré fielmente su recompensa \q y haré con ellos un pacto que dure para siempre.
es.R: Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, amo lo que es justo. \q Aborrezco el robo y toda clase de mal. \q Seré fiel y le daré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo lo que se ha ganado. \q Haré con ellos un pacto que durará para siempre.

fr.L: Car moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’aime le droit ; \q je hais la rapine avec l’injustice ; \q et je leur donnerai leur salaire avec fidélité, \q et je conclurai avec eux une alliance éternelle.
fr.B: Car moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’aime le droit \q et je déteste le vol joint à l’injustice. \q Je leur paierai fidèlement leur salaire \q et je conclurai avec eux une alliance qui durera toujours.
fr.R: Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’aime ce qui est juste. \q Je déteste le vol et toute sorte de mal. \q Je serai fidèle et je donnerai à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ce qu’il a mérité. \q Je ferai avec lui une alliance qui durera toujours.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, napenda hukumu; \q nachukia unyang'anyi pamoja na uovu; \q nami nitawapa ujira wao kwa uaminifu, \q na agano la milele nitafanya nao.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ni mpenda haki, \q nami nachukia unyang'anyi unaoambatana na uovu. \q Nitawalipa ujira wao kwa uaminifu \q na kufanya nao agano litakalodumu milele.
sw.R: Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, napenda yaliyo haki. \q Nachukia wizi na kila aina ya uovu. \q Nitakuwa mwaminifu na kuwapa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kile walichostahili. \q Nitafanya nao agano litakalodumu milele.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, yêu công lý; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ghét sự cướp bóc kèm sự bất chính; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trả công cho họ cách thành tín, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập với họ một giao ước đời đời.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là Đấng yêu công lý \q và ghét sự cướp đoạt đi kèm điều sai trái. \q Ta sẽ thành tín trả công cho họ \q và lập với họ một giao ước còn mãi đời đời.
vi.R: Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, yêu điều công bằng. \q Ta ghét sự trộm cắp và mọi điều sai trái. \q Ta sẽ thành tín ban cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} những gì họ đáng được. \q Ta sẽ lập với họ một giao ước còn mãi mãi.

ko.L: 참으로 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 정의를 사랑하고, \q 불의로 빼앗는 것을 미워한다. \q 내가 진실하게 그들의 품삯을 주고, \q 그들과 영원한 언약을 맺겠다.
ko.B: 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 정의를 사랑하고, \q 불의와 결합된 강탈을 미워한다. \q 나는 그들에게 품삯을 진실하게 갚아 주고, \q 그들과 영원히 이어질 언약을 맺겠다.
ko.R: 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 공정한 것을 사랑한다. \q 나는 도둑질과 온갖 나쁜 일을 미워한다. \q 내가 신실하게 내 백성에게 그들이 받아야 할 것을 주겠다. \q 내가 그들과 영원히 이어질 언약을 맺겠다.

pt.L: Pois eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, amo a justiça; \q odeio o roubo com injustiça; \q e darei o salário deles com fidelidade, \q e uma aliança eterna farei com eles.
pt.B: Pois eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, sou amigo da justiça \q e odeio o roubo junto com a maldade. \q Eu lhes pagarei fielmente o seu salário \q e farei com eles uma aliança que dura para sempre.
pt.R: Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, amo o que é justo. \q Odeio o roubo e todo tipo de maldade. \q Serei fiel e darei ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo aquilo que ele ganhou. \q Farei com eles uma aliança que vai durar para sempre.

am.L: እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ፍርድን እወዳለሁና፤ \q ከበደል ጋር ዝርፊያን እጠላለሁ፤ \q ዋጋቸውንም በታማኝነት እሰጣለሁ፤ \q ከእነርሱም ጋር የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን እገባለሁ።
am.B: እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ፍትሕን የምወድ ነኝና፤ \q ከክፋት ጋር የተቀላቀለ ዝርፊያንም እጠላለሁ። \q ዋጋቸውን በታማኝነት እከፍላቸዋለሁ፤ \q ለዘላለም የሚኖርም ቃል ኪዳን ከእነርሱ ጋር እገባለሁ።
am.R: እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትክክለኛውን ነገር እወዳለሁ። \q ስርቆትንና ማንኛውንም ክፋት እጠላለሁ። \q ታማኝ ሆኜ ሕዝቤ የሠሩበትን እሰጣቸዋለሁ። \q ለዘላለም የሚኖር ቃል ኪዳን ከእነርሱ ጋር እገባለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, न्याय से प्रेम करता हूँ; \q मैं अन्याय के साथ की गई लूट से घृणा करता हूँ; \q और मैं सच्चाई से उनकी मज़दूरी दूँगा, \q और उनके साथ सदा की वाचा बाँधूँगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि मैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, न्याय से प्रेम रखता हूँ \q और अन्याय से जुड़ी लूट से घृणा करता हूँ। \q मैं विश्वासयोग्यता से उन्हें उनकी मज़दूरी दूँगा \q और उनके साथ ऐसी वाचा बाँधूँगा जो सदा बनी रहेगी।
hi.R: मैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जो उचित है उससे प्रेम करता हूँ। \q मैं चोरी और हर तरह के अन्याय से घृणा करता हूँ। \q मैं विश्वासयोग्य रहूँगा और अपनी प्रजा को वह दूँगा जो उन्होंने कमाया है। \q मैं उनके साथ ऐसी वाचा बाँधूँगा जो सदा बनी रहेगी।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, люблю правосудие, \q ненавижу грабёж с неправдой; \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам им их плату по верности \q и завет вечный заключу с ними.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, люблю правосудие \q и ненавижу грабёж, соединённый с неправдой. \q Я верно отдам им их плату \q и заключу с ними завет, который будет длиться вечно.
ru.R: Я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, люблю то, что справедливо. \q Я ненавижу воровство и всякое зло. \q Я буду верен и дам {{deity_pronoun:моему|Моему}} народу то, что он заработал. \q Я заключу с ними завет, который будет длиться вечно.

ja.L: まことに、わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は公正を愛し、 \q 不正による略奪を憎む。 \q わたしは真実をもって彼らに報酬を与え、 \q 永遠の契約を彼らと結ぶ。
ja.B: わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は公正を愛する者、 \q 不正と結びついた略奪を憎む。 \q わたしは真実をもって彼らに報いを与え、 \q 永遠に続く契約を彼らと結ぶ。
ja.R: わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、公平なことを愛する。 \q 盗みや、あらゆる悪を憎む。 \q わたしは誠実に、わたしの民が受けるべきものを与える。 \q いつまでも続く契約を、彼らと結ぶ。

decisions.choice: robbery with wrongdoing: the vowels of the Masoretic text read "wrongdoing"
decisions.reason: The same consonants can be read "burnt offering", giving "robbery in a burnt offering" (an offering made from stolen goods; compare 1:11-17; Malachi 1:13). The vowels of the Masoretic text give "wrongdoing", and the Septuagint is reported to read it the same way (from memory; to be checked).

decisions.choice: their wages; a covenant forever: God will faithfully give his people what is due to them and bind himself to them for good
decisions.reason: "Wages" here means the reward God gives (40:10; 49:4; 62:11). The everlasting covenant is promised in 55:3 and Jeremiah 32:40.

decisions.choice: my people
decisions.reason: Readable names "them" as God's people, as the context shows.

decisions.choice: "나 주는 ... 사랑한다" in God's own 해라체, after the anointed speaker's words of verses 1-7
decisions.reason: God speaks in the first person in verses 8-9 ("I, the LORD"), so the honorific drops away, as the terms note sets for God's speech.

decisions.choice: justice (mishpat) "ፍርድ" (L), "ፍትሕ" (B), "ትክክለኛውን ነገር" (R, the English "what is fair"); faithfulness "ታማኝነት"
decisions.reason: As the terms list: "ፍርድ" also means a verdict, so Balanced says "ፍትሕ" where the sense is justice; Readable follows the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "सच्चाई से" (L); "विश्वासयोग्यता से" (B); "विश्वासयोग्य रहूँगा" (R)
decisions.reason: God's faithfulness follows the poetry note: "सच्चाई" at Literal, "विश्वासयोग्यता" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: gazel be'olah "不正による略奪" (L), the Masoretic vowels (m1; the footnote gives "burnt offering"); berit 'olam "永遠の契約" (L), "永遠に続く契約" (B, R), as ISA-3 24:5; mishpat "公正" (L, B), "公平なこと" (R).
decisions.reason: The settled covenant and justice words.

source.text: וְנוֹדַ֤ע בַּגּוֹיִם֙ זַרְעָ֔ם וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעַמִּ֑ים כָּל־רֹֽאֵיהֶם֙ יַכִּיר֔וּם כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע בֵּרַ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And will be known among the nations their offspring, and their descendants in [the] midst of the peoples; all [who] see them will recognize them, that they [are] offspring [whom] Yahweh has blessed.

en.L: And their offspring will be known among the nations, \q and their descendants amid the peoples; \q all who see them will recognize them, \q that they [are] offspring [that] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed.
en.B: Their children will be famous among the nations, \q and their descendants among the peoples. \q Anyone who sees them will recognize them \q as a line of children whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed.
en.R: Their children and grandchildren will be famous among the nations. \q Everyone who sees them will know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed them.

es.L: Y su descendencia será conocida entre las naciones, \q y sus vástagos en medio de los pueblos; \q todos los que los vean los reconocerán, \q que son descendencia [que] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido.
es.B: Sus hijos serán famosos entre las naciones, \q y sus descendientes entre los pueblos. \q Todo el que los vea los reconocerá \q como un linaje que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido.
es.R: Sus hijos y sus nietos serán famosos entre las naciones. \q Todos los que los vean sabrán que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los ha bendecido.

fr.L: Et leur descendance sera connue parmi les nations, \q et leurs rejetons au milieu des peuples ; \q tous ceux qui les verront les reconnaîtront, \q [ils sauront] qu’ils [sont] une descendance que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a bénie.
fr.B: Leurs enfants seront célèbres parmi les nations, \q et leurs descendants parmi les peuples. \q Tous ceux qui les verront les reconnaîtront \q comme une lignée que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a bénie.
fr.R: Leurs enfants et leurs petits-enfants seront célèbres parmi les nations. \q Tous ceux qui les verront sauront que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a bénis.

sw.L: Na uzao wao utajulikana kati ya mataifa, \q na wazao wao kati ya watu wa mataifa; \q wote wanaowaona watawatambua, \q kwamba wao [ni] uzao [ambao] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameubariki.
sw.B: Watoto wao watajulikana sana kati ya mataifa, \q na wazao wao kati ya watu wa mataifa. \q Yeyote anayewaona atawatambua \q kuwa ukoo wa watoto ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewabariki.
sw.R: Watoto wao na wajukuu wao watajulikana sana kati ya mataifa. \q Kila mtu anayewaona atajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewabariki.

vi.L: Và dòng dõi họ sẽ được biết đến giữa các dân tộc, \q và con cháu họ ở giữa các dân; \q mọi người thấy họ sẽ nhận ra họ, \q rằng họ [là] dòng dõi [mà] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước.
vi.B: Con cái họ sẽ nổi danh giữa các dân tộc, \q và dòng dõi họ giữa các dân. \q Ai thấy họ cũng sẽ nhận ra \q họ là dòng dõi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước.
vi.R: Con cháu họ sẽ nổi tiếng giữa các dân tộc. \q Ai thấy họ cũng sẽ biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 자손이 민족들 가운데 알려지고, \q 그들의 후손이 백성들 가운데 [알려질 것이다]. \q 그들을 보는 자들은 모두 그들을 알아볼 것이다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 복을 준 자손인 줄을.
ko.B: 그들의 자손이 민족들 가운데 널리 알려지고, \q 그들의 후손이 백성들 가운데 알려질 것이다. \q 그들을 보는 사람마다 \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 복을 준 자손인 줄 알아볼 것이다.
ko.R: 그들의 자녀와 손자들이 민족들 가운데 널리 알려질 것이다. \q 그들을 보는 사람은 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들에게 복을 주었다는 것을 알게 될 것이다.

pt.L: E a descendência deles será conhecida entre as nações, \q e os seus descendentes no meio dos povos; \q todos os que os virem os reconhecerão, \q que eles [são] uma descendência [que] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou.
pt.B: Os filhos deles serão famosos entre as nações, \q e os seus descendentes entre os povos. \q Quem os vir vai reconhecê-los \q como uma geração de filhos que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou.
pt.R: Os seus filhos e netos serão famosos entre as nações. \q Todos os que os virem vão saber que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} os abençoou.

am.L: ዘራቸውም በሕዝቦች መካከል ይታወቃል፤ \q ልጆቻቸውም በወገኖች መካከል [ይታወቃሉ]፤ \q የሚያዩአቸው ሁሉ ያውቋቸዋል፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የባረከው ዘር እንደ ሆኑ።
am.B: ልጆቻቸው በሕዝቦች መካከል ዝነኞች ይሆናሉ፤ \q ዘሮቻቸውም በወገኖች መካከል ይታወቃሉ። \q ያያቸው ሁሉ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የባረካቸው የልጆች ትውልድ መሆናቸውን ያውቃል።
am.R: ልጆቻቸውና የልጅ ልጆቻቸው በሕዝቦች መካከል ዝነኞች ይሆናሉ። \q የሚያያቸው ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ባረካቸው ያውቃል።

hi.L: और उनका वंश जातियों के बीच जाना जाएगा, \q और उनकी सन्तान लोगों के बीच; \q जो कोई उन्हें देखेगा, वह उन्हें पहचान लेगा, \q कि वे वह वंश [हैं जिसे] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने आशीष दी है।
hi.B: उनकी सन्तान देशों में प्रसिद्ध होगी, \q और उनके वंशज लोगों के बीच। \q जो कोई उन्हें देखेगा, वह पहचान लेगा \q कि यह वह वंश है जिसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने आशीष दी है।
hi.R: उनके बच्चे और नाती-पोते राष्ट्रों में प्रसिद्ध होंगे। \q जो कोई उन्हें देखेगा, वह जान लेगा कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उन्हें आशीष दी है।

ru.L: И будет известно среди народов их потомство \q и их отпрыски — среди племён; \q все видящие их узнают их, \q что они — потомство, [которое] благословил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Их потомки будут известны среди народов, \q и их дети — среди племён. \q Всякий, кто увидит их, узнает в них \q род, который благословил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Их дети и внуки будут известны среди народов. \q Каждый, кто их увидит, поймёт, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} благословил их.

ja.L: 彼らの子孫は国々の中で知られ、 \q 彼らのすえは諸国の民の中で[知られる]。 \q 彼らを見る者はみな、彼らを認める、 \q 彼らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の祝福した子孫であることを。
ja.B: 彼らの子どもたちは国々の中で名を知られ、 \q その子孫は諸国の民の中で知られる。 \q 彼らを見る者はみな、 \q 彼らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の祝福した家系であることを認める。
ja.R: 彼らの子どもや孫たちは、国々の中で有名になる。 \q 彼らを見る人はみな、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が彼らを祝福したことを知る。

decisions.choice: offspring the LORD has blessed: the promise to Abraham fulfilled
decisions.reason: God promised to bless Abraham's offspring and make them a blessing to the nations (Genesis 12:2-3; 22:17-18). In 65:23 the people are again "offspring blessed by the LORD".

decisions.choice: the nations "ሕዝቦች" and the peoples "ወገኖች" in the paired lines
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets where the two Hebrew words stand side by side.

decisions.choice: Inside God's speech (61:8 "I, the LORD") the LORD's blessing is plain ("主の祝福した", R "主が……祝福した"), not an honorific, as ISA-6 41:20.
decisions.reason: God does not honour himself.

source.text: שׂ֧וֹשׂ אָשִׂ֣ישׂ בַּֽיהוָ֗ה תָּגֵ֤ל נַפְשִׁי֙ בֵּֽאלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י הִלְבִּישַׁ֨נִי֙ בִּגְדֵי־יֶ֔שַׁע מְעִ֥יל צְדָקָ֖ה יְעָטָ֑נִי כֶּֽחָתָן֙ יְכַהֵ֣ן פְּאֵ֔ר וְכַכַּלָּ֖ה תַּעְדֶּ֥ה כֵלֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Rejoicing I will rejoice in Yahweh; will exult my soul in my God, for he has clothed me [in] garments of salvation; [with] a robe of righteousness he has wrapped me, like a bridegroom [who] acts as priest [with] a turban, and like a bride [who] adorns [herself with] her jewels.

en.L: Rejoicing I will rejoice in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; my soul will exult in my God, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has clothed me [in] garments of salvation; \q [in] a robe of righteousness {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has wrapped me, \q as a bridegroom serves as priest [with] a turban, \q and as a bride adorns [herself with] her jewelry.
en.B: My joy in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} overflows; my whole being delights in my God. \q He has dressed me in clothing of salvation \q and wrapped me in a cloak of righteousness, \q like a bridegroom wearing a turban as a priest does, \q like a bride decked out in her jewels.
en.R: I am filled with joy because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. With all my heart I celebrate my God. \q He has dressed me in salvation like new clothes. \q He has wrapped me in righteousness like a coat. \q I am like a bridegroom wearing a fine turban like a priest. \q I am like a bride putting on her jewelry.

es.L: En gran manera me gozaré en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; mi alma se regocijará en mi Dios, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me ha vestido [con] ropas de salvación; \q [con] manto de justicia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me ha envuelto, \q como el novio que se pone la diadema como un sacerdote, \q y como la novia que se adorna [con] sus joyas.
es.B: Mi alegría {{divine_name:en el SEÑOR|en Yahvé}} se desborda; todo mi ser se deleita en mi Dios. \q Me ha vestido con ropas de salvación \q y me ha envuelto en un manto de justicia, \q como un novio que lleva un turbante como el de un sacerdote, \q como una novia adornada con sus joyas.
es.R: Estoy lleno de alegría por causa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Con todo mi corazón celebro a mi Dios. \q Me ha vestido de salvación como de ropa nueva. \q Me ha envuelto en justicia como en un abrigo. \q Soy como un novio que lleva un fino turbante como un sacerdote. \q Soy como una novia que se pone sus joyas.

fr.L: Je me réjouirai, je me réjouirai dans {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; mon âme exultera en mon Dieu, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a revêtu des vêtements du salut ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a enveloppé du manteau de la justice, \q comme un époux qui se coiffe d’un turban à la manière d’un prêtre, \q et comme une épouse qui se pare de ses bijoux.
fr.B: Ma joie déborde en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; tout mon être se réjouit en mon Dieu. \q Il m’a habillé des vêtements du salut \q et m’a enveloppé d’un manteau de justice, \q comme un époux qui porte un turban comme un prêtre, \q comme une épouse parée de ses bijoux.
fr.R: Je suis rempli de joie à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. De tout mon cœur, je fais la fête pour mon Dieu. \q Il m’a habillé de salut comme de vêtements neufs. \q Il m’a enveloppé de justice comme d’un manteau. \q Je suis comme un marié qui porte un beau turban comme un prêtre. \q Je suis comme une mariée qui met ses bijoux.

sw.L: Nitafurahi sana katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nafsi yangu itashangilia katika Mungu wangu, \q kwa maana amenivika mavazi ya wokovu; \q [kwa] joho la haki amenifunika, \q kama bwana arusi anavyovaa kilemba kama kuhani, \q na kama bibi arusi anavyojipamba [kwa] vito vyake.
sw.B: Furaha yangu katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} inafurika; moyo wangu wote unamfurahia Mungu wangu. \q Amenivalisha mavazi ya wokovu \q na kunifunika kwa joho la haki, \q kama bwana arusi anayevaa kilemba kama kuhani, \q kama bibi arusi aliyejipamba kwa vito vyake.
sw.R: Nimejaa furaha kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa moyo wangu wote ninamshangilia Mungu wangu. \q Amenivika wokovu kama nguo mpya. \q Amenifunika kwa haki kama koti. \q Mimi ni kama bwana arusi aliyevaa kilemba kizuri kama kuhani. \q Mimi ni kama bibi arusi anayevaa vito vyake.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ hết sức vui mừng trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; linh hồn tôi sẽ hớn hở trong Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã mặc cho tôi [bằng] y phục cứu rỗi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã khoác cho tôi áo choàng công chính, \q như chàng rể đội khăn như thầy tế lễ, \q và như cô dâu trang điểm [bằng] nữ trang của mình.
vi.B: Niềm vui của tôi trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tràn ngập; cả con người tôi hân hoan trong Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. \q Ngài đã mặc cho tôi y phục cứu rỗi \q và khoác cho tôi áo choàng công chính, \q như chàng rể đội khăn như thầy tế lễ, \q như cô dâu đeo trang sức lộng lẫy.
vi.R: Tôi tràn đầy niềm vui vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tôi hết lòng vui mừng trong Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. \q Ngài đã mặc cho tôi sự cứu rỗi như áo mới. \q Ngài đã khoác cho tôi sự công chính như áo choàng. \q Tôi giống như chàng rể đội chiếc khăn đẹp như thầy tế lễ. \q Tôi giống như cô dâu đeo nữ trang của mình.

ko.L: 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로 말미암아 크게 기뻐하고, 내 영혼이 나의 하나님 안에서 즐거워할 것이다. \q 그분이 나에게 구원의 옷을 입히시고, \q 의의 겉옷을 나에게 둘러 주셨기 때문이다. \q 신랑이 제사장처럼 머리쓰개를 쓰는 것같이, \q 신부가 패물로 단장하는 것같이 [하셨다].
ko.B: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로 말미암아 기쁨이 넘치고, 내 온 존재가 나의 하나님 안에서 즐거워한다. \q 그분이 나에게 구원의 옷을 입혀 주시고, \q 의의 겉옷으로 나를 감싸 주셨다. \q 신랑이 제사장처럼 머리쓰개를 쓴 것같이, \q 신부가 패물로 꾸민 것같이 해 주셨다.
ko.R: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 때문에 기쁨이 가득하다. 나는 온 마음으로 나의 하나님을 기뻐한다. \q 그분이 새 옷을 입히시듯 나에게 구원을 입혀 주셨다. \q 그분이 겉옷을 둘러 주시듯 의로 나를 감싸 주셨다. \q 나는 제사장처럼 멋진 머리쓰개를 쓴 신랑과 같다. \q 나는 패물로 단장하는 신부와 같다.

pt.L: Com alegria me alegrarei {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}; a minha alma exultará no meu Deus, \q pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me vestiu [com] roupas de salvação; \q [com] um manto de retidão {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me envolveu, \q como um noivo [que] faz de sacerdote [com] um turbante, \q e como uma noiva [que] se orna [com] as suas joias.
pt.B: A minha alegria {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}} transborda; todo o meu ser se encanta com o meu Deus. \q Ele me vestiu com roupas de salvação \q e me envolveu numa capa de retidão, \q como um noivo que usa turbante como um sacerdote, \q como uma noiva enfeitada com as suas joias.
pt.R: Tenho uma grande alegria por causa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. De todo o coração eu celebro o meu Deus. \q Ele me vestiu de salvação como de roupas novas. \q Ele me envolveu em retidão como num casaco. \q Sou como um noivo que usa um belo turbante como um sacerdote. \q Sou como uma noiva que põe as suas joias.

am.L: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ደስ እያለኝ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ነፍሴም በአምላኬ ሐሴት ታደርጋለች፤ \q የመዳንን ልብስ አልብሶኛልና፤ \q የጽድቅንም መጎናጸፊያ አጎናጽፎኛል፤ \q ሙሽራ እንደ ካህን ጥምጥም እንደሚጠመጥም፣ \q ሙሽሪትም በጌጣጌጧ እንደምታጌጥ።
am.B: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ደስታዬ ሞልቶ ይፈስሳል፤ መላ ሕይወቴ በአምላኬ ሐሴት ያደርጋል። \q የመዳንን ልብስ አልብሶኛል፤ \q የጽድቅንም ካባ አጎናጽፎኛል፤ \q ካህን እንደሚያደርገው ጥምጥም እንደ ጠመጠመ ሙሽራ፣ \q በጌጣጌጧም እንዳጌጠች ሙሽሪት ሆኛለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ምክንያት በደስታ ተሞልቻለሁ። በፍጹም ልቤ በአምላኬ ደስ ይለኛል። \q መዳንን እንደ አዲስ ልብስ አልብሶኛል። \q ጽድቅን እንደ ካባ አጎናጽፎኛል። \q እንደ ካህን ያማረ ጥምጥም የጠመጠመ ሙሽራ መስያለሁ። \q ጌጣጌጧን የምታደርግ ሙሽሪት መስያለሁ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} में मुझे अति आनंद ही आनंद होगा; मेरा प्राण मेरे परमेश्वर में मगन होगा, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने मुझे उद्धार के वस्त्र पहनाए हैं; \q धार्मिकता के चोगे [से] उन्होंने मुझे ढाँप दिया है, \q जैसे दूल्हा याजक के समान पगड़ी [बाँधता] है, \q और जैसे दुल्हन अपने गहनों [से अपने आप को] सजाती है।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} में मेरा आनंद उमड़ता है; मेरा पूरा मन मेरे परमेश्वर में मगन है। \q उन्होंने मुझे उद्धार के वस्त्र पहनाए हैं \q और धार्मिकता का चोगा मुझे ओढ़ाया है, \q उस दूल्हे के समान जो याजक की तरह पगड़ी बाँधे है, \q उस दुल्हन के समान जो अपने गहनों से सजी है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के कारण मेरा मन आनंद से भरा है। मेरा पूरा मन अपने परमेश्वर में उत्सव मनाता है। \q उन्होंने मुझे उद्धार को नए कपड़ों की तरह पहनाया है। \q उन्होंने धार्मिकता को चोगे की तरह मुझे ओढ़ाया है। \q मैं उस दूल्हे के समान हूँ जो याजक की तरह सुंदर पगड़ी बाँधे है। \q मैं उस दुल्हन के समान हूँ जो अपने गहने पहन रही है।

ru.L: Радуясь, буду радоваться в {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕ|Яхве}}; возликует моя душа в моём Боге, \q ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} облёк меня в одежды спасения; \q одеянием праведности {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} окутал меня, \q как жених, священнодействующий в венце, \q и как невеста, украшающая [себя] своими драгоценностями.
ru.B: Моя радость о {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЕ|Яхве}} переполняет меня; всё моё существо ликует в моём Боге. \q Он одел меня в одежды спасения \q и окутал меня плащом праведности, \q как жених, надевающий венец, как священник, \q как невеста, украшенная своими драгоценностями.
ru.R: Меня наполняет радость благодаря {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Всем сердцем я ликую о моём Боге. \q Он одел меня в спасение, как в новую одежду. \q Он окутал меня праведностью, как плащом. \q Я как жених, который надел красивый венец, как у священника. \q Я как невеста, которая надевает свои украшения.

ja.L: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にあって、喜びに喜ぶ。わたしの魂は、わたしの神のゆえに躍り上がる。 \q その方が、わたしに救いの衣を着せ、 \q 義の外套をわたしにまとわせてくださったからだ。 \q 花婿が祭司のように頭飾りを着け、 \q 花嫁が宝玉で身を飾るように。
ja.B: わたしの喜びは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にあってあふれ、わたしは全身でわたしの神を喜ぶ。 \q その方が、わたしに救いの衣を着せ、 \q 義の外套で包んでくださったからだ。 \q 祭司のように頭飾りを着ける花婿のように、 \q 宝石で身を飾る花嫁のように。
ja.R: わたしは、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のゆえに、喜びでいっぱいだ。心の底から、わたしの神をたたえて祝う。 \q その方は、救いを新しい着物のように、わたしに着せてくださった。 \q 正しさを上着のように、わたしにまとわせてくださった。 \q わたしは、祭司のように立派なかぶり物を着けた花婿のようだ。 \q 宝石を身に着ける花嫁のようだ。

decisions.choice: the speaker: Zion, or the anointed one of verse 1, rejoicing in what God has done
decisions.reason: The speaker is not named. It may be Zion or her people answering the promises (compare the bride in 49:18; 62:5). It may be the anointed one of verses 1-3 speaking again. The joy is the same either way: God has clothed the speaker in salvation.

decisions.choice: garments of salvation, a robe of righteousness: God gives his people the clothing he himself wears
decisions.reason: In 59:17 the LORD puts on righteousness as armor and salvation as a helmet. Priests are clothed with salvation and righteousness in Psalm 132:9, 16. Revelation 19:7-8 and 21:2 picture the bride of the Lamb dressed for her wedding.

decisions.choice: serves as priest with a turban: the bridegroom puts on a fine headdress like a priest's
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the word for priest. The word for turban is used of the priests' headdresses (Exodus 39:28) and of the mourners' new turban in verse 3.

decisions.choice: My joy overflows / I am filled with joy
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis; Balanced and Readable express the emphasis without the repetition that Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: Tenho uma grande alegria
decisions.reason: The speaker may be Zion or the anointed one (m1). Portuguese adjectives show gender, so Readable says "Tenho uma grande alegria" rather than "Estou cheio/cheia de alegria", which would decide who speaks; Literal and Balanced need no adjective.

decisions.choice: "ደስ እያለኝ ደስ ይለኛል" for the doubled verb (rejoicing I will rejoice)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew repetition, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say the intensity in ordinary Amharic.

decisions.choice: "मुझे ... आनंद होगा", "मेरा मन ... मगन है": wording that leaves the speaker's gender open
decisions.reason: The speaker may be Zion or the anointed one of verse 1 (meaning m1). Hindi first-person verbs show the speaker's gender, so the verse is phrased with "मुझे", "मेरा मन" and "हूँ", which do not, and the reading stays open as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: the speaker's "я", "меня", "моя" without deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The speaker is Zion or the anointed one of verse 1 (m1), not God; the pronouns are written plainly, as the English has them; the wording avoids gendered past forms, since the speaker may be Zion (feminine) or the anointed one.

decisions.choice: sos 'asis "喜びに喜ぶ" (L), keeping the doubled verb; bigdei yesha' "救いの衣", me'il tsedaqah "義の外套" (L, B), "正しさ" (R): the clothing God himself wears in 59:17 (m2), so 義 as ISA-6; the speaker's praise takes light respect forms ("着せ……てくださった"). Composed away from the familiar versions' wording.
decisions.reason: The settled words for God's saving righteousness.

source.text: כִּ֤י כָאָ֨רֶץ֙ תּוֹצִ֣יא צִמְחָ֔הּ וּכְגַנָּ֖ה זֵרוּעֶ֣יהָ תַצְמִ֑יחַ כֵּ֣ן׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה יַצְמִ֤יחַ צְדָקָה֙ וּתְהִלָּ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For like the earth [that] brings forth its growth, and like a garden [that] makes its sown things sprout, so [the] Lord Yahweh will make sprout righteousness and praise before all the nations.

en.L: For like the earth [that] brings out its shoots, \q and like a garden [that] makes its sown [seeds] spring up, \q so the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will make spring up righteousness and praise before all the nations.
en.B: As the ground pushes up its new growth, \q as a garden makes its seeds break through the soil, \q so the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will make righteousness and praise grow up in full view of every nation.
en.R: Plants come up out of the ground, and seeds grow in a garden. \q In the same way, the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will make righteousness and praise grow. \q All the nations will see it.

es.L: Porque como la tierra produce sus brotes, \q y como el huerto hace brotar lo sembrado, \q así el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} hará brotar justicia y alabanza delante de todas las naciones.
es.B: Así como la tierra hace salir sus brotes nuevos, \q así como un huerto hace que sus semillas broten de la tierra, \q así el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} hará crecer la justicia y la alabanza a la vista de todas las naciones.
es.R: Las plantas brotan de la tierra, y las semillas crecen en un huerto. \q De la misma manera, el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} hará crecer la justicia y la alabanza. \q Todas las naciones lo verán.

fr.L: Car comme la terre fait sortir ses pousses, \q et comme un jardin fait germer ses semences, \q ainsi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} fera germer la justice et la louange devant toutes les nations.
fr.B: Comme le sol fait monter ses jeunes pousses, \q comme un jardin fait percer ses semences, \q ainsi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} fera grandir la justice et la louange sous les yeux de toutes les nations.
fr.R: Les plantes sortent de la terre, et les graines poussent dans un jardin. \q De la même façon, le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} fera pousser la justice et la louange. \q Toutes les nations le verront.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama nchi itoavyo machipukizi yake, \q na kama bustani ichipushavyo [mbegu] zilizopandwa ndani yake, \q ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} atakavyochipusha haki na sifa mbele ya mataifa yote.
sw.B: Kama ardhi inavyotoa machipukizi yake mapya, \q kama bustani inavyofanya mbegu zake zitokeze juu ya udongo, \q ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} atakavyofanya haki na sifa zichipuke mbele ya kila taifa.
sw.R: Mimea huota kutoka ardhini, na mbegu huota bustanini. \q Vivyo hivyo, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} ataifanya haki na sifa ziote. \q Mataifa yote yataona jambo hili.

vi.L: Vì như đất làm mọc lên cây cỏ của nó, \q và như vườn làm cho [hạt giống] gieo trong đó nảy mầm, \q thì Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng sẽ làm cho sự công chính và lời ca ngợi nảy mầm trước mặt mọi dân tộc.
vi.B: Như đất đẩy chồi non lên, \q như khu vườn làm cho hạt giống trồi lên khỏi mặt đất, \q thì Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cũng sẽ làm cho sự công chính và lời ca ngợi mọc lên trước mắt mọi dân tộc.
vi.R: Cây cỏ mọc lên từ đất, và hạt giống nảy mầm trong vườn. \q Cũng vậy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm cho sự công chính và lời ca ngợi lớn lên. \q Mọi dân tộc sẽ thấy điều đó.

ko.L: 참으로 땅이 그 싹을 내고, \q 동산이 거기 뿌린 것을 돋아나게 하듯이, \q 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 모든 민족 앞에서 의와 찬양을 돋아나게 하실 것이다.
ko.B: 땅이 새싹을 밀어 올리고, \q 동산이 뿌린 씨앗을 흙 위로 돋아나게 하듯이, \q 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 모든 민족이 보는 앞에서 의와 찬양이 자라나게 하실 것이다.
ko.R: 땅에서 식물이 올라오고, 동산에서 씨앗이 자란다. \q 그와 같이 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 의와 찬양이 자라나게 하실 것이다. \q 모든 민족이 그것을 보게 될 것이다.

pt.L: Pois, como a terra [que] faz sair os seus brotos, \q e como um jardim [que] faz germinar as suas sementes, \q assim o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} fará germinar a retidão e o louvor diante de todas as nações.
pt.B: Como o chão faz brotar as plantas novas, \q como um jardim faz as sementes romperem a terra, \q assim o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} fará a retidão e o louvor crescerem à vista de todas as nações.
pt.R: As plantas saem da terra, e as sementes crescem num jardim. \q Do mesmo jeito, o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} vai fazer a retidão e o louvor crescerem. \q Todas as nações vão ver isso.

am.L: ምድር ቡቃያዋን እንደምታወጣ፣ \q የአትክልት ቦታም የተዘራበትን እንደሚያበቅል፣ \q እንዲሁ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጽድቅንና ምስጋናን በሕዝቦች ሁሉ ፊት ያበቅላል።
am.B: መሬት አዲስ ቡቃያዋን እንደምታወጣ፣ \q የአትክልት ቦታም ዘሩን ከአፈር እንደሚያበቅል፣ \q እንዲሁ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጽድቅንና ምስጋናን በሕዝቦች ሁሉ ፊት ያበቅላል።
am.R: ተክሎች ከመሬት ይበቅላሉ፤ ዘሮችም በአትክልት ቦታ ያድጋሉ። \q እንዲሁም ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጽድቅንና ምስጋናን ያበቅላል። \q ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ያዩታል።

hi.L: क्योंकि जैसे भूमि अपनी उपज उगाती है, \q और जैसे बग़ीचा अपने बोए हुए [बीजों] को उगाता है, \q वैसे ही प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} सब जातियों के सामने धार्मिकता और स्तुति को उगाएँगे।
hi.B: जैसे भूमि अपने नए अंकुर निकालती है, \q जैसे बग़ीचा अपने बीजों को मिट्टी फोड़कर उगाता है, \q वैसे ही प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} सब देशों के देखते-देखते धार्मिकता और स्तुति को उगाएँगे।
hi.R: पौधे ज़मीन से निकल आते हैं, और बग़ीचे में बीज उग आते हैं। \q उसी तरह प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} धार्मिकता और स्तुति को उगाएँगे। \q सब राष्ट्र इसे देखेंगे।

ru.L: Ведь как земля выводит свои ростки \q и как сад заставляет взойти посеянное в нём, \q так Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} взрастит праведность и хвалу перед всеми народами.
ru.B: Как земля выпускает свою молодую поросль, \q как сад даёт пробиться посеянным семенам, \q так Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} взрастит праведность и хвалу на глазах у всех народов.
ru.R: Растения поднимаются из земли, и семена прорастают в саду. \q Так и Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} заставит расти праведность и хвалу. \q Все народы увидят это.

ja.L: まことに、地がその芽を生え出させ、 \q 園がまかれた種を芽生えさせるように、 \q {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、義と賛美を、すべての国々の前に芽生えさせられる。
ja.B: 大地が新しい芽を出し、 \q 園がまかれた種を芽吹かせるように、 \q {{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、義と賛美を、すべての国の前に芽生えさせてくださる。
ja.R: 地面から草木が生え、園で種が芽を出す。 \q そのように、{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、正しさと賛美を育ててくださる。 \q すべての国々が、それを見る。

decisions.choice: make righteousness spring up: God makes right order and rescue grow among his people, as surely as plants grow
decisions.reason: "Righteousness" here includes the setting right of Zion's cause (62:1-2). The picture of righteousness sprouting appears in 45:8 and Psalm 85:12.

decisions.choice: the growth is God's work, seen by all nations
decisions.reason: Just as soil and garden bring up what is planted in them, the Lord GOD causes the growth; the nations see it and praise follows (60:3; 62:2).

decisions.choice: "Владыка ГОСПОДЬ"
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH has the form the prophets note gives, as in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: tsedaqah "義" (L, B), "正しさ" (R): right order and rescue God makes grow (m1), ISA-6; tsimchah "その芽" and yatsmiach "芽生えさせる", not "若枝", which is kept for the messianic tsemach (4:2).
decisions.reason: The settled words; the plant words kept plain.
